September 1-9, 2025
This is a great place to hang out, but it may not be suitable for living and sleeping for sensitive persons.
Life here is in full swing until 1 am and longer, especially on the national holidays.
The living room and the room with a twin bed overlook a busy street.
In the evening, the air is dirty due to the huge number of smokers, relaxing in nearby cafes.
The apartment matches the photos, quite large and cozy.
There were some issues in the apartment that I've been solving with the host for a couple of days.
Weak internet, in some places in the apartment there is no signal.
A half of one of the queen beds creaks.
Nehir tried to smooth out all the rough edges and did everything that is in her capabilities. She is a wonderful host.

The apartment has a great location with plenty of cafés and restaurants nearby. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and the host was responsive and easy to communicate with.
That said, the apartment could use some renovation. The mattress in one of the bedrooms was extremely firm. There was also black mold on the bathroom ceiling and an unpleasant sewage smell coming from the drain.
A few things to be aware of (not necessarily negatives, depending on your needs):
- the area is lively with many bars so earplugs are recommended,
- one of the bedrooms does not have AC,
- the building has no elevator.

Nehir is very friendly and responsive. She will do her best to address all questions and concerns. The location is prime in Kadikoy and walkable to the ferry which we took everyday. It takes us about a 50 minute commute into the European side everyday. Prices are much cheaper in Kadikoy than in the more central tourist neighborhoods. Although it is central in Kadikoy, it is not loud if you close the doors and windows. We found it enjoyable to be in a lively atmosphere where we could hang out late into the night, eat street food, and walk to multiple bars. The AC is strong and made the stay more comfortable, it’s located in the living room and one of the two bedrooms.
If I came back to Istanbul, I would strongly consider staying here again!

If you want to be in a roomy home in the heart of Kadakoy, this is the place to be. Top floor, no elevator but it really wasn’t a problem for us. It was comfortable and we would stay here again. It’s about a 12-15 minute entertaining walk (with some hills) to the Ferry to hit up the rest of Istanbul. Host was responsive to our needs and very welcoming. Enjoy your time on the Asian side of Istanbul.

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this place centrally located.
The building has a very pleasant communal terrace.

reviews.text:
Absolutely fantastic stay!
Outside: there’s plenty to do, easy walk to any of the public transport, loads of restaurants and even a convenience store very close by, a short walk to Galata Tower and Istiklal Street.
Inside: very clean, very welcoming, and very comfortable! The main space was much more spacious than the photos looked. The private porch was very nice to enjoy through the day, I didn’t have a chance to go up to the roof, but there were clear instructions left on how to get up there. The Internet was a little slow but I’m attributing that to the Internet provider not the host. The bed was comfortable but a little more firm than what I’m use to, but 10x better than the hotel I stayed at my first few nights. If I come back to Istanbul I will try and get this flat again!

We had a super-comfortable week-long stay here. We were able to self-checkin thanks to very clear instructions from the host, Nurdan (who we never met, but who was super-prompt in responding to all our queries/texts).
The apartment is located very close to the Galata Tower but in a side-street so away from the noise and the crowds. It was close to both the Sishane metro station and Tophane tram station so it was very convenient to use public transport to go everywhere.
The apartment was exactly as per the photos - a large living room cum open kitchen, spacious bathroom and a small-ish bedroom. Like other reviews mention, it is a basement apartment so no natural light in the bedroom (it didn't bother us since we went there only to sleep at nights). Despite it's location close to the Galata Tower, it was quiet enough to not bother even a light sleeper like me.
The shower was hot, the host provided drinking water (which was great!) and the washer and dryer were very convenient!

Great place! Incredible location near Galeta tower, clean, appliances all worked, good spot overall. The location doesn’t get much daylight but some might consider that a good thing (helped me get over jet lag easier and sleep in on New Year’s Day). It is incredibly quiet given the central location. And the main living area is more spacious than the photos indicate.

Location was amazing with Galata Tower right around the corner, a grocery store steps away, lots of food options, and the train a 10 minute walk away. Nurdan was very kind and helpful. Apartment was clean and spacious. Wifi was strong and able to work remotely without an issue. Complimentary water jugs were also really nice.

This place is fantastic! It is actually bigger than shown in the photos.
The bed was super comfortable and the place is slightly dark so you can sleep very well.
The place is very close to nice restaurants, bars and cafés.
The terrasse is a perfect addition and offers a nice view. I can only recommend this place and would gladly go back if I visit Istanbul again.
The hosts were very nice and responsive, although I barely needed any help, everything went smoothly.
Thank you guys!

description: Welcome to our cute 1 bedroom 1 bathroom home with private outdoor terrace space to enjoy! Tucked away on a quiet street in the heart of modern Bebek! 7 minutes walk to the shore-line and all the best restaurants and cafes! Situated on the ground floor of a free standing home. Comes with a fully equipped kitchen, private outdoor space, high speed internet, fresh linens and towels! Our home is the perfect home away from home:)

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a great stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The check-in process was easy, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout my stay. The location was convenient, and everything I needed was available. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Bebek. The place was clean and spacious, which made it feel so comfortable from the moment I arrived.
The apartment is located in a beautiful and vibrant neighborhood, with easy access to the Bosphorus, charming cafes, and restaurants. The host was incredibly helpful and responsive, making the entire stay from check-in to check-out very smooth.
Overall, this apartment exceeded my expectations, and I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. I would definitely be back for another stay.

We had a great stay! The place was very clean and had everything needed for a comfortable, cozy vibe. The bathroom is quite narrow, but it wasn’t an issue for us. Everything was exactly as described, and the host was friendly and very communicative. Would definitely stay again!

Amazing location. The apartment is old but clean, small, and comfortable for two people. The only downside is the long staircase, which can be challenging if you have a lot of luggage, a stroller, or mobility issues. The bathroom is also quite small, but it was clean. Overall, the area is fantastic and made the stay very enjoyable. ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆

The apartment is relatively small but well-situated in the heart of Bebek. However, since the building is not on the main road, accessibility can be quite difficult for guests with physical disabilities. In addition, the bathroom is very narrow anyone weighing over 100 kilos may find it almost impossible to enter comfortably, so this is worth noting.
That said, the host was consistently proactive and attentive, and the apartment itself was comfortable.

description: Located in Beyoglu, it is a historical building built in 1890 and recently renovated. With a space of 300 sqm, 5B+2.5 Bathrooms. We are loc on Gulbaba street, it is a detached house. With its brick walls finished w modern art paintings and its 4m high ceilings decorated w murals by the best artists of its time, our authentic apt promises a memorable journey through Istanbul’s history. The apt consists of high speed wi-fi service, as well as fully equipped bathrooms & kitchen.

reviews.text:
Overall our 7 nights stay there was ok but there are many things that wish were different . I would not rent it again and neither would Recomend it.
1) there are no utensils in the kitchen . And I am talking about basics stuff like a spatula por example . Furthermore there is no microwave.
2) I haven’t noticed it on the pictures but in 2 bedrooms there are no beds . The mattress is laying directly on the floor .
3) I agree with some previous comments that the bed sheets need to be changed to fitted bedsheets . The towels were ok .
4) it is so cold on the ground floor and the heater in the dining room didn’t work properly .
Overall the place looks old and dusty .

Just wow. The hosts always replied within minutes, helped us organise transport, were open for flexible check-in and check-out. Beautiful house in the perfect location in Istanbul. Very well taken care of, modern, and clean. Quiet, but close to bars, good restaurants, hamam, bakeries, and public transport, everything in 10 minute walking distance. Can't believe that we found it. Incredibly well priced. We absolutely loved it! Thanks so much! 5++ star rating if it would exist.

We had a wonderful stay and everything was absolutely top-notch. Mayer was a fantastic host — welcoming, responsive, and always quick to help with any questions. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We felt right at home from the moment we arrived and would happily stay again. Highly recommended

The house is in an excellent location. Though it took us a while to realise that taxis couldn’t get directly to it. It is in the heart of Beyoglu and very convenient for the tram at the bottom of the hill.
The house is very spacious and clean and has good clothes storage in each room. We enjoyed having a room each and were just four people. With just two bathrooms 10 people may struggle. The water pressure and temperature were very good. The house is nice but lacks a cosy feel which we put down to the lighting.
Responsiveness was very good from the host.

⸻
We had a wonderful stay at this house. It is very spacious—perfect for our group of five, as each of us was able to have our own bedroom. The area is quiet and peaceful, and we all slept very well. We also enjoyed the presence of many stray cats around the house, which added a lovely, local charm to our stay.
The bathroom and water facilities were excellent, and the entire house was very clean. The only minor issue we encountered was some ants on the first floor, but after I contacted the host, he immediately arranged for pest control. They came twice to make sure the issue was resolved, which we truly appreciated.
There was also a time when my parents returned to the house earlier than us and didn’t have a key. We contacted the host in an emergency, and he promptly brought the spare key to the house. We are very grateful for his help and responsiveness.
I highly recommend this house and its thoughtful host. If we have the chance, we would love to stay here again.

description:
Our apartment, which stands out with its modern design and comfortable living space, is an ideal choice for both business trips and urban stays.
It is a 4-5 minute walk to the Güzelyurt Metrobus stop and only 4 stops to the TUYAP Fair Center.
It is a few steps away from the bazaar, market and daily needs and is centrally and safely located.
It offers a comfortable stay with a queen size bed, air conditioning and a fully equipped kitchen.
Contactless check-in is available.
IDENTIFICATION is mandatory.

reviews.text:
Daireden çok memnun kaldım. TÜYAP Fuarı için konakladım ve konum olarak gerçekten harikaydı. TÜYAP’a çok yakın, metrobüse yürüme mesafesinde, ulaşım çok kolay ve rahattı.
Tüyap fuarına gelenler için harika bir seçim olabilir.
Ev temiz, düzenli ve konforluydu. Ev sahibi de oldukça canayakın ve ilgiliydi her sorduğum soruya anında cevap verdi.
Lora hanıma çok teşekkür ederim gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederim.
The AC was not working and also the bedroom was not cleaned
Konum, temizlik, olanaklar herşey harikaydı. ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi. artık burası İstanbul'da ki evim diyebilirim. Herşey için teşekkürler.

Her şey antıldığı gibi ev gayet temiz ve hoş. Eşyalar gayet yeterli. Konum metrobüse 2-3 dk mesafede ve kolay giriş olması gerçekten çok pratik. Lora’ya her an ulaşabilirsiniz ve hızlıca yardımcı oluyor ☺️
Gayet sorunsuz, temiz ve sakin bir konaklama geçirdim gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Uzun zamandır kendimi bu kadar rahat hissettiğim bir konaklama yeri ile karşılaşmamıştım. Emre Bey her konuda hızlı geri dönüş sağladı ve yardımcı oldu. Kendisine çok teşekkür ederim. Daire fotoğraflardaki gibi aynı, konforlu ve rahat edebileceğiniz bir yerdir. Şiddetle tavsiye ederim...

Its nice place and the host absolutely kind and and 24/7 responding to inquiries but missing the air conditioning and u dont need to expect so much i mean its a small building u will be living and hearing all the Istanbul noice and with Modest furniture
Konum olarak rahat ulaşımın oldugu odanın gösterildiği gibi olduğunu soyleyebilirim

Öncelikle Şahin beyin ilgisi ve kibarlığı için teşekkür ederim.Arkadaşım ile misafir olarak kaldığımız daire resimlerdeki gibidir, giriş ve çıkışların kolaylığı,temizlik ve her detayın düşünülmesi profesyoneliği ön planda olması bir sonraki konaklama da tercih etmemize neden olacaktır. Sevgiler.
guzel bir konaklamaydi sahin bey sag olsun cok ilgiliydi dairenin konumu da merkeziydi kolayca bulduk memnun kaldik

description:
Your suite with balcony is located in Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, one of the liveliest areas of Istanbul

With 24/7 transportation, you can easily reach every corner of the city and discover shopping, entertainment, coastal walks and places with Bosphorus views in minutes

I provide comfort and 24/7 reception support where my guests can feel at home

There is also a terrace with a view of the Bosphorus in the common area within the facility

reviews.text: Overall great stay, very helpful stuff at the reception who carried the luggage up and down the stairs for me (the elevator only goes from the second floor). The room was clean and spacious, the bathroom also clean, but there is some issue with the pipes and so I was concerned about not leaking downstairs neighbours. As for the terrace upstairs (I went after dark), it was a bit dangerous because the stairs are steep and practically impossible to find the lights. But the view is great. And location is 10/10, 5 min from Istaklal street and 10 min from Karakoy pier by feet.

I had a fantastic stay! The apartment was exactly as described—comfortable, and in a great location. Fatih and his Team was very kind and responsive, making sure I had everything I needed. Check-in was smooth, and the place had all the amenities to make my stay enjoyable. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to others!

Ankara’dan İstanbul’a gerçekleştirdiğimiz iş seyahati kapsamında üç gece boyunca Galata Rooms’ta konakladık. Hem merkezi konumu hem de otopark imkânları açısından son derece memnun kaldık. Fatih Bey, ihtiyaç duyduğumuz her an bizimle birebir ilgilendi. Diğer ekip üyeleri de aynı derecede yardımsever ve ilgiliydi. Terası ne yazık ki konaklamamızın sonuna doğru keşfettik, ancak gece manzarası gerçekten etkileyiciydi. Gelecek İstanbul seyahatlerimizde de ilk tercihimiz yine Galata Rooms olacaktır. Tüm hizmetler için içten teşekkür ederiz.
We stayed at Galata Rooms for a 3-night business trip from Ankara to Istanbul and were very pleased. The central location and parking facilities were excellent. Mr. Fatih was attentive throughout our stay, and the team was equally helpful. We discovered the terrace late, but the night view was stunning. We’ll gladly choose Galata Rooms again on future visits. Thank you for everything.

My stay at Rooms Galata was excellent.
Loved my room - high ceilings, very comfortable bed, lovely linens and very spacious.
The hosts are super friendly and did everything they could to make me feel welcome as well as offering great recommendations.
Location wise I’d say it’s pretty unbeatable - very easy to walk to lots of attractions, restaurants, shops, and the area is super interesting with tons of little streets to wander around and explore.
I’ve since moved to a fancy-ish hotel (only for the pool) but already miss the room and space at Galata. I’d definitely recommend this place if you’re looking to stay in a more authentic space in a great area.

The location is central. On a very steep hill.
The room is spacious but could do with a deep clean.
The doors to bathroom do not fully close & you can’t lock the bathroom.
There is quite a lot of mould/dirty grout in bathroom.
Sofa in bedroom looks dirty.
A lot of surface dust on window ledges.
Floor is stained. Rug could do with a hoover & wooden flooring is splintered in places.

description: Right next to the Avcılar Şükrübey metrobus stop, in a new building, at affordable prices for the opening.

reviews.text:
As soon as we checked in, we were informed by the receptionist that the room was an economic room, which was never clarified in the Airbnb listing.
The room was nothing like the pictures shown when booking, and it was also not disclosed that the accommodation was actually a hotel.
The room was extremely small, to the point where it was difficult to move around. The bathroom was even worse. When standing up from the toilet, you would hit your head on the door handle due to the lack of space.
The room was very noisy. Around 8:00 in the morning, there was a loud, constant noise coming from outside. When we checked, it turned out to be a generator. Because of this, we could not sleep properly during the two nights we stayed.
Additionally, there was no Wi-Fi available, and the host was not helpful or supportive when we raised these issues.
Overall, it was a terrible experience. Before booking, if you are sensitive to noise or value comfort and sleep, this place is not suitable.

I have reserved the room for my guest who was visiting from abroad , we need clean comfortable room for our guest ,he was happy to stay and he gave tumps up for the place , this place is located on E5 has easy access to Metrobus and Marmaray train station therefore we selected this place and worked well for us. We had easy checkin with friendly stuff. Highly recommended and would stay here again.

It was just beside the metro bus station. It is a hotel. It was very clean and pleasant. The electric kettle was not clean though. And there were no shoes 👟 for the bathroom. Everything else was great.

The room was absolutely amazing - very spacious, spotlessly clean, and extremely cozy. Everything was perfectly maintained and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. Everything exceeded my expectations!
A special thank you to the girls at the reception - they were incredibly kind, helpful, and welcoming, especially the girl named Hadil ❤️Her warm attitude truly made my stay even better. Highly recommended!

The room was absolutely amazing - very spacious, spotlessly clean, and extremely cozy. Everything was perfectly maintained and made me feel comfortable from the moment I arrived. Everything exceeded my expectations!
A special thank you to the girls at the reception - they were incredibly kind, helpful, and welcoming. Their warm attitude truly made my stay even better. Highly recommended!

description: Welcome to your dream stay in Balat, one of Istanbul’s most charming and historic neighborhoods! This brand-new, fully renovated 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers a luxurious escape with breathtaking water views and a terrace the perfect blend of modern comfort and authentic charm. Premium linens and a cozy bed. Relax in the living room and channel your inner chef in a fully equipped kitchen. Comes with Wifi!

reviews.text:
The rooms are same as the pictures however the building design was not clear, it was 5 small levels as you need to go up and down for each room:
Level -1 is Turkish bath and washing machine,
Level 0 is entrance, kitchen and toilet only with sink not working,
Level 1 is living room, hand sink and shower only hot water available later,
Level 2 bed room, balcony, hand sink and shower only no hot water,
Level 3 balcony, bar, hand sink and toilet only.
The house doesn't have AC so Im not sure if its fit for summer.
The hot water was not working when I request a maintenance they only fixed 1 shower bath out of 4 - as a co they may send me to another apartment belong to thier group if the apartment was not ready.
I stacked in the balcony and I send to them for help the first thing they send me after 40 min was a rule and link to pay to send someone to get me out of the balcony as they can charge me later by anyway.
At night there is a bad smell comes out near the entrance wall.

Fantastic location, in probably the best neighborhood of Istanbul. Colourful and interesting without being overrun by crowds, or a boat ride away from the centre. Layout is all vertical, so you'll need to use a spiral staircase between rooms. Hamam in the basement is very cool, and highly recommended! Method is: 1. Heat yourself up with the shower 2. Soap/shower gel + warm water in the sink, pour it over yourself with the dish 3. Rinse off with shower.
Only minor negative is traffic noise, so bring earplugs.

Not too many bad things to say!
The house was in the middle of a popular tourist destination so it felt like a safe area to live in, along with many things being near by.
The house itself was very clean, and you could tell that there was a lot of thought put into the design (even the light switches were satisfying) and it was an incredibly aesthetic and comfy home.
A few things that weren’t optimal were the semi transparent doors on the toilets and showers, along with the door handle for the basement shower being completely destroyed when we first came into the home. There also isnt any AC in the house, which isnt always a problem as the house is naturally pretty cold and the fans are sufficient for anything up to 30C.
Overall a great stay, will surely come here if i ever visit istanbul again!

A wonderful house in the center of the vibrant and atmospheric Balat neighborhood. The advantages include the feeling of being in your own multi-story building, two balconies, two showers, and two toilets. The disadvantages include: if you eat breakfast at home, you have to cook it on the ground floor, and the only comfortable place to eat is on the fourth floor. However, it's a good morning cardio workout. On the first floor, the kitchen sink faucet barely holds and needs repairing. There are missing teaspoons for the dishes. It's also a shame there was no salt.
We weren't able to check if the sauna, located in the basement, was working.
Hot water is much more reliable on the second floor, where the living room is. On the third floor, where the bedroom is, the pressure is weaker.
However, overall, these are all fairly minor issues that didn't detract from our wonderful stay in this apartment.

5-story apartment! Great place to stay with a great view for those who like to climb stairs. Beautiful terrace on the top. Really good restaurants and cafes nearby. Good tourist location with a lot of little shops with souvenirs. Ferry ⛴️ station is really close, so it’s very fast and easy to get to the city center. If you want spa and hammam experience - make sure if it’s not out of service. Thank you for such good stay!

description:
It can easily accommodate 4 people, has a sea view, two double beds,
a private kitchen
a private bathroom
a private toilet
a comfortable room
We believe you will have a peaceful vacation when you are a guest.

reviews.text: The building and the room are low cost and need maintenance and better quality. We were expecting more from the photos. The location is good and very central (however if you have any problems with the legs, please have in mind that the residential area has slopes and the building has stairs). It is within walking distance (max. 15 min.) to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazar. Public transportation - 10 min. walk to tram T1, 20 minutes walk to metro M2 and 25 min. walk to B1 line (Marmaraway). The host, Melike, was always responsive and the lady who was in the building and responsible for the room was always available.

The place was clean, check-in was easy—even though we arrived after midnight, someone was there to welcome us—and the host stayed responsive throughout. The location is excellent: walking distance to Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, and just a 7-minute walk to the tram.
The sea view was nice, though it’s from a distance—you can see the water but not the shore. We did have a power outage the first morning, which was a bit inconvenient, though we’re not sure if that’s a common issue in Istanbul. Also, the apartment is on the second floor with many stairs, which made access difficult with kids and luggage. It’s better suited for light travelers or couples.
One surprise was that someone entered and cleaned the apartment while we were out on the second day. At first it felt intrusive, but once we saw everything was intact and spotless—including the bathroom and dishes—we appreciated the gesture.
Overall, a clean and well-located place for travellers without mobility or luggage concerns

This Airbnb was as described and great value for money. The location was optimal with the Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and other monuments being walking distance. If you arrive via tram, note you will have to walk down some steep streets. The host didn’t speak English but this wasn’t an issue. Would recommend staying here!

The room was exactly as described in the photos, and the location was excellent. We could easily walk to all the main attractions, which made our stay very convenient.
Whenever we needed help, there was usually a staff member available and easy to find. The room was also very quiet and comfortable.
We stayed in the family room as two adults and two children, and we had a wonderful experience. The host was very warm and welcoming, proactively checking if we needed anything and always easy to contact.
Istanbul was absolutely wonderful, and we stayed for 10 days, creating many beautiful memories. Thank you so much for your hospitality and for making our stay so enjoyable!

The house is clean and worth the money you pay. The owner is trustworthy. The only thing is that it is a 20 minute walk to the metro and bus station. The room was a little smaller than expected.
Excellent access to the old city of Istanbul and the Istanbul Wholesale Market.
Thanks to Melike and Ms. Gul.

description:
A stylish and comfortable studio apartment located in a historic building in the heart of Beyoğlu. The apartment features a comfortable bed, private bathroom, kitchen, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and other essential amenities.Its central location offers easy access to Istiklal Street, Galata Tower and Karaköy, making it an ideal choice for exploring Istanbul. The building also features a lobby for guests.
Important: For security reasons, we cannot accommodate guests without a confirmed reservation.

reviews.text: We had a great stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts were friendly, responsive, and made everything easy from check-in to check-out. The location was convenient and we really enjoyed our time here. Highly recommended, and we would be happy to stay again. Thank you!

Host is very kind and helpful. Room was very comfortable, very nice shower and bed. I loved the big windows and the beautiful painted flowers on the wall.⚘️ There is a şok market near by and many other food places. Taksim metro is only 14 minute walk away.
I recommend this place, is clean, quiet, and cozy. 😊
Thank you so much.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at this cozy studio in Istanbul! From the moment I arrived, everything exceeded my expectations. The location is unbeatable — nestled in a quiet street but just minutes away from bustling cafes, restaurants, and historic landmarks like the Galata Tower and Istiklal Street. It made exploring the city incredibly easy.
The studio itself was spotless, stylish, and thoughtfully equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay — including a very comfortable bed, fast Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and a well-stocked kitchenette. I especially appreciated the little touches, like complimentary tea and coffee and helpful travel tips provided by the host.
Speaking of the host, they were outstanding — warm, responsive, and genuinely invested in making sure my stay was perfect. They even offered to help with transportation and provided local recommendations that made my visit feel more authentic and special.

I enjoyed my stay here, overall. The room is nicely decorated, as in the photos. Location is good. Very attentive hosts.
A few things to note:
-Given the steep hill on which the house is built, this 1st-floor apartment is not entirely above ground. The hosts told me that the window overlooks the neighbor’s yard, however, it is slightly below it. It cannot be termed a basement apartment either, however, since there is a space between the building and the neighbor’s property. Nevertheless, the apartment receives decent light and feels good inside.
-The bed has a spring mattress, which I personally did not find very comfortable.
-After checking in, the hosts sent me a message saying that no guests are allowed in the building at any time of day. They said that it would be illegal to have a guest – is it? If this is something that the hosts are going to prohibit, then it should be made clear in the listing.

The room is different from the photos, the room is quite dark and had white main light, thanks to the host for bringing yellow light, the shower room is quite dark. We had to keep the faucet turned off so that there was no pressure in the pipes, but the owner assured us that this would be fixed. In the basics everything is good, the host was quick to respond and always helpful. In spite of some inconveniences, I recommend this apartment

description: Experience the charm of Istanbul in our stylish apartment located in a historical building in the heart of Galata. Tastefully decorated with traditional Turkish motifs, the space comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests. Enjoy being just steps away from local markets, iconic landmarks, and a wide range of restaurants and cafes.

reviews.text:
I would describe the unit as a totally fine place to stay. I think you can probably find something that's a better value.
It's spacious, well decorated and in a great area. Pretty view. Hosts are quick to respond.
The beds aren't comfortable. Each bed had only 2 VERY stiff pillows. On my bed the bottom/ only sheet didn't even fully cover the mattress. The duvet was empty/flat. No blanket. It was super sparse and the photos make it look cozy.
There were some things that need maintenance. We didn't ask them to do it during our stay but I'm leaving it in the private review. Ex: the shower didn't drain at all. It honestly felt like they weren't really expecting us.
This is mentioned in other reviews but want to stress that it's tiring to climb to the third floor. Hall lights are automatic and SLOW. You're in the dark and it smells.
You can hear noises from other units so not the place for you if you're a light sleeper.
I can't totally recommend this place, but it wasn't bad.

The apartment was just one street away from the Galata tower which meant that the area was very lively and touristy. The metro station was just a few minutes walk away and same with the tram which is really handy for getting around. The flat is nice and does come with cooking essentials. And they do offer to hold your baggage on the check out day if your flight is later on.
However, we found false eyelashes in one of the beds and bathroom, boiled vegetables left in the kettle? And the bedding in the first bedroom had hairs in it and bubbly, but other than that the apartment was clean.
Also the AC in the living room blows warm air even on the coldest setting so need to use the bedroom AC's too cool the apartment down but it does cool down quite fast
flat is on the 3rd floor with no elivator so you will be out of breath when coming back to the apartment. The apartment is also located on the middle of a steep hill which is full of men stood around all day. But great host communication
The apartment is just as described. It’s very comfortable, clean and well located. The hosts were easy to deal with and were very responsive to queries and even allowed us to check in early.

The place was nice, well located, and clean.
Air conditioning in every room.
Just like in the photos.
The nights were quiet, regardless of the fact that the place was on a touristic street in the city.
We had a comfortable stay!

This place was beautiful and we always looked forward to coming back to it after a day of adventuring in Istanbul. The living room was our favourite place - so cozy and lovely.
We also really loved the balcony and made use of it often, relaxing by it for breakfast and dinner.
The location was excellent, very central and within walking distance of great restaurants and transport. And despite this we didn’t notice much noise.
All of the rooms had air conditioning and the house was always cool despite heat outside.
The kitchen was good but sometimes found there weren’t enough plates. The bathroom was spacious and clean but sometimes we had trouble with the sliding door.
Overall we had a lovely time staying in this apartment and would happily stay again.

description:
Alex is located on Moda Street in the heart of Istanbul. The Bull Statue and the Rıhtıma (Port) are only a few steps away. You can walk to the Seaside in 5 minutes. Our apartment has new, well-equipped furniture. We try to think of everything for your comfort.

Entertainment Centers are here.
Nazım Hikmet Cultural Center is here.
Metro, Metrobus, Tram, Bus, Taxi Stops are very close by.

reviews.text: I had an extra day at the end of my last trip to Istanbul and wanted to spend the day in my favourite part of Kadikoy. This place was right in the middle of all the action, surrounded by cool shops, cafes, restaurants. Lively, fun vibe! The room was cool, clean, and perfect for me to crash there for a few hours before leaving at 3 am to catch an early flight home. I should mention that the location is VERY noisy -- not just the hustle and bustle from a bopping, fun neighbourhood until past midnight, but also because it is located directly next to a mosque. At prayer time, the loudspeakers atop the minarets are pointed directly at the building, going through the open windows, so that the singing feels like it is at full blast volume right in the room. So it was fine for a night, but if you're planning to stay longer, I'd recommend some serious earplugs if you want a peaceful slumber. Still it's a great value for a minor trade-off.

Konum olarak çok merkezi ve güzel bir yer. İstanbul’da ne zaman konaklamam gerektiyse burayı tercih ettim. Ve pişman etmedi beni. Ev sahibi çok hızlı dönüş sağlıyor ve çok nazik . Th AC did not really work, the place is kind of falling apart, it’s definitely a smoking room, I would have checked out after the first night preferred staying in a hostel.

description: Nostalgia Home tastefully renovated furnıshed with brand new and stylish furnitures. Kitchen allowing you to cook and enjoy meals at home. Our building includes 11 individual units, each one has own facilities (bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, balcony, fan) , only a few steps away from İstiklal Aveneu that is the most popular touristical spot in Istanbul. Even though its unique location, also far from all the city comotion (club disco traffic-street noise) that will provide you a peaceful stay.

reviews.text:
The two previous comments were completely accurate. The host was very responsive, helpful and considerate.
The only problem was the internet being too slow. Although there were many routers but all of them were reachable/had good speed if you were near the entrance door.
One thing that we loved about this place, was the location. It was near the Istiklal street and at the end of it, was Taksim square, making it viable to visit some of the best parts of Istanbul.
The location was also close to the port and bus stations.

I had a wonderful stay! The apartment is comfortable, clean, and well-equipped. The location is great, just a short walk from Taksim Square. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Communication was excellent because I always received quick responses, and both check-in and check-out were completely hassle-free. Unfortunately, I have to mention that I would not recommend the area, as it felt unsafe. Even several taxi drivers warned me that the neighborhood is considered dangerous and advised me to be careful. I would recommend researching the area beforehand, especially Tarlabaşı, to get a better impression.
In addition, the unpleasant smell in the bathroom, which has already been mentioned in several previous reviews, was unfortunately still present during my stay. The bed sheets also had visible stains, which was disappointing and affected the overall cleanliness experience.

Pros:
Really fantastic value for money. For the price you can’t go wrong. Big room, really decent sized bathroom. Check in was super easy with lockbox. The place is also within a 5 minute walk to Istiklal too (no crazy hills). 4 complimentary waters, and a nice view if you’ve got the time to enjoy it.
Cons:
In the summer heat, could do with AC instead of a fan. And perhaps a few more toiletries would have been nice.

We loved our few nights here and would definitely recommend this place to stay. It’s in a great walkable location to metros and buses and some good nightlife and restaurants! It has all you need for a few nights stay in Istanbul!
The wifi is not the strongest/ fastest but it was perfectly fine for us and just basic use.
Thankyou for our stay Nostalgia hotel!

description: We recommend you to stay in our charming apartment, which is located right next to Taksim Square, in the city center, just 5 minutes away from the airport bus stop. The advantage of this apartment is that we can wait for you nearby or meet you at any convenient time. You don't need to take a taxi. A bus from the airport will bring you directly to the next street!It is also easy to get anywhere in Istanbul from here with the Taksim metro!

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this apartment. First and foremost coming from other places with steep stairs I was relieved to find out it was a ground unit. Easy access to and from the street made it so convenient.
The place was super clean upon check-in and everything was as it had shown in the photos / description.
Living room is super comfortable equipped with a smart tv for your nights in. Kitchen has all the necessities and appliances if you wish to cook for yourself or reheat takeout.
Bathroom felt new and clean with modern finishes. Didn’t have any issue with water temperature or pressure.
Bedroom was spacious and comfortable. They had provided extra linens and throws.
Felt really safe and secure. The surroundings are quiet but at the same time right in the heart of all the activity. A short walk to everywhere.
There is a 24h grocery store up the street.
I would definitely stay here again and would recommend for others who want a nice, clean, and convenient stay.

This was my second stay at the apartment, and once again everything was great. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It feels very welcoming, which is why I chose to come back. The host was responsive and helpful, and the location was convenient. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to others.

This was our 7th & final Airbnb in Turkey & it was by far the best. For the same price (or less) as a hotel, you get the space, comfort & convenience of a home instead of being confined to a small hotel room. The location is fantastic. Just a short walk to Taksim Square, the airport shuttle, Metro, buses, Istiklal Caddesi, supermarkets, cafés & countless restaurants. The apartment is very spacious, clean & beautifully decorated with thoughtful touches throughout. It felt welcoming from the moment we arrived. The amenities were excellent & went above what we’ve experienced elsewhere. There’s a smart TV with Netflix, a kettle, microwave, washing machine, & even olive oil for cooking(the only Airbnb on our trip that provided it!). We also appreciated the extras like tea, coffee, laundry liquid, shampoo, shower gel, & even a little Turkish delight treat upon arrival. For such a central location, the apartment was surprisingly quiet at night. Highly recommend.

My boyfriend and I really enjoyed our stay in Mehmet’s flat. Super responsive & friendly hosts. The flat was cosy, comfortable, clean, and spacious with everything we needed. The AC was much appreciated in the heat. Super central location close to transport to go all around the city (both Europe and Asia side), good restaurants and cafes nearby as well as nightlife. We highly recommend for your stay!

If you plan on staying outside of the old city (Sultanahmet) this is your place!!! Price was fantastic for a 7 night stay and the location was ideal for Metro and nightlife. This apartment was cozy, clean and absolutely perfect minus the very steep hill it sits upon, so bring your most comfortable pair of walking shoes. Literally a five minute walk to Taksim Square and the Metro which you will rely upon daily for your trips to old town and other districts. The very top of Iskalal street sits right across from Taksim Square as well. Restaurants and street food galore. It's a lively neighborhood with a beautiful mosque across from Taksim as well so if you don't mind normal everyday life noise then this is your place. You will hear call to prayer several times a day and evening but to me it was beautiful and pure Istanbul. OH and that red swinging chair ~ my highlight after a long day of walking the streets. If I could have fit that chair in my suitcase I would have. Thank you Mehmet!!

description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, just steps from Galata Tower, metro, tram, and bus stops. Surrounded by cozy cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, and local attractions, our apartment offers the perfect base to explore the city. Easy access to all major sights and lively neighborhoods makes it ideal for both short and long stays!

reviews.text: The location was great, close to everything we wanted to see. It is a very hilly location of Istanbul so get ready to get a good workout. Istanbul was built on 7 hills, this area is one of them. Public transportation is great in istanbul be it taxi, metro or by foot. The apartment was exactly as described with very clear instructions. We had a great stay, beds very comfortable, 2 showers, lots of room to spread out. Cemoli was very responsive, thank you! Our key did not work one day and Cemoli got the problem sorted out in about an hour. Some noise at night due to location and being an older historic building windows are not soundprooof. The light in the hallway and stairs do not come on until you have reached the first floor and stays on for a short period of time. Maybe that could be fixed somehow for safety.

The apartment was perfect in every way. Everything was clean, modern, and exactly as described. The location is fantastic — close to everything but still quiet and comfortable. One of the highlights was the shared rooftop terrace, which has a beautiful view and was a great place to relax. The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay. We would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

Fantastic place in a perfect location! Very clean, cozy, and close to the Galata Tower and public transportation. The host was kind and responsive, and everything was exactly as advertised. We loved our stay and would definitely come back. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Everything was great and brand new. The location is perfect, the apartment is fully equipped with everything you need, and all the furniture is practical and well-chosen. Cemil is a very helpful and responsive host. The shared rooftop terrace is beautiful and offers an amazing view. It’s a perfect apartment for families, with two air conditioners and very comfortable beds. Highly recommended!

Close to Galata tower. If you are coming with young kids, best to uber or get a taxi to the air bnb rather than train. House was good, clean and has everything you need. We were out most of the day. Its a 10 min walk to tram, 2 min walk to galata tower. You will be going down hill and up the hill quite a lot. We were in touch with Baris as our host and he was helpful and responsive.

description: Our newly furnished hotel is in Yenikapı/Fatih area (Old Town). We provide in all our rooms a kettle, a mini fridge, an air conditioner, a hair dryer, a set of clean towels etc.. Keep in mind that there is not lift. The hotel located in heart of the city. Aksaray tram is 4-5 mins. Yenikapi Metro and Marmaray stations are 500 meters away. Walkeable distance to Grand Bazaar. Easy to find everything around, supermarkets, cafes, local restaurants, local shops etc.

reviews.text: The location and responsiveness of the host was great, and the host even helped us arranging a taxi ride to airport at 5am however the room itself was unfortunately subpar to pictures and our expectations. Biggest issue was the musty smell in bathroom and unlike the pictures, there was no window. The bed was comfortable but the covers were stained, so was the curtains. There was dust all over the window sills and I dont think the windows were cleaned in months. The room was tiny but we knew that beforehand. Overally, for 1 or 2 nights it might do but wouldn’t recommend for longer stays

I had a really comfortable stay at this room in Fatih. The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as shown in the photos. The location is perfect very close to the main attractions, public transport, and lots of food options.
The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in super easy.
Overall, it was a great stay and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Daha önce konakladığım bi oteldi sadece bu sefer farklı bi oda türünde kaldım. Önceki konaklamam gibi bu seferde derli toplu, temiz ve ferah bi odada kaldım. Ev sahibi güler yüzlü ve her zaman yardımcıydı, eğer bu civarlarda bi otel arıyosanız hem fiyatının hakkını veren hem de ulaşım seçeneklerine çok yakın gayet güzel bi otel. Tavsiye edilir.

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel and would highly recommend it. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with everything needed for a relaxing stay. The staff were friendly, professional, and always willing to help with any questions or requests.
The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the area and access nearby attractions. I was also impressed by the quality of the facilities and the overall atmosphere of the hotel. Everything felt welcoming and well organized.

Overall, my stay was good for the price I paid. I paid around $40, so I did not expect anything luxurious, and the hotel met my expectations in terms of value.
The only downside was that there was no drinking water available. I arrived late at night and couldn't find any water to drink or even make a cup of tea, which was quite inconvenient after a long journey.
For the price, it is a reasonable place to stay, but providing complimentary drinking water would make the experience much better.

reviews.text:
The location was perfect and close to everything. It’s a bit noisy since it’s a crowded and popular neighborhood,for people sensitive to noise, it might be a bit uncomfortable.
The house itself was really good, though smaller than it looks in the pictures. The bathroom was uncomfortably small.I wouldn’t recommend it for older people because it’s difficult to move around.
The kitchen was compact but very good, and all the kitchen equipment was pretty new and in great condition. The refrigerator, however, wasn’t working properly,everything we put inside got frozen.
There’s a washing machine for clothes, but no dryer, so it wasn’t very practical since we couldn’t dry our clothes and had to use the nearby laundry service instead.
They also provide daily cleaning service, Special thanks to Amar and the rest of the cleaning team.
We were four people, but I would recommend it for two, as it felt a bit small for four guests.
it was a good stay for one week and we really enjoyed.

Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğünden çok daha güzel ve tertemizdi, ev sahibi ihtiyaç olabilecek her şeyi düşünmüş, en önemlisi yatak,banyo ve mutfak temizliğiydi, evin salonundan açılan küçük bahçenin hemen yanında restoran var akşamları dolu olduğu için insanların sesi ve müzik oluyor fakat kapıyı kapattığınızda ilginç bir şekilde hiçbir ses gelmiyor bu sayede çok rahat uyudum, tvde neredeyse bütün platformlar mevcut, ev sahibi beyefendi ve nazik biri her şey için teşekkür ediyorum, gönül rahatlığıyla burayı tercih edip merkezi konumu sayesinde her yere kolayca ulaşım sağlayabilirsiniz.
Place was in very nice location, was very clean when we checked in and Host was very understanding when i had to check in early!
Lokasyon ve hostun hızlı dönüşleri bizim için çok değerliydi. Ancak, banyo ve yatacak yerlerdeki temizlik eksikti. Geceleri yatak üstündeki camdan gelen seste rahatsız ediciydi.

description: The apartment is located in the lively, historical and touristic Kadıköy Bazaar area. It is close to Kadıköy Coast, Fenerbahçe Stadium and many entertainment venues, bars, restaurants, Kadıköy fishermen's bazaar, performance stages and theater show centers. Since our apartment is located in the center of Kadıköy, it is within walking distance to all public transportation. I recommend that you make a reservation knowing that it is a 35-40 year old building and that there may be noise from the bars around and below it.

reviews.text: Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev hem tertemiz hem de fotoğraflarda göründüğünden çok daha güzeldi. Konumu oldukça merkezi ve ulaşım açısından çok rahattı. Ev sahibi son derece ilgili, hızlı iletişim kuran ve yardımcı biriydi. Kendimizi gerçekten evimizde gibi hissettik. Tekrar gelmeyi kesinlikle düşünürüm. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz 🙏

Biret was extremely helpful and professional. The place was as described; clean, spacious and well designed. On top of that the location is gorgeous if you’re looking to enjoy the bustling beauty of Istanbul. Definitely will be my top choice when I come back to this city again!

Ev konumu açısından çok avantajlı, eğer geceleri dışarıdan gelecek olan gürültüden rahatsız olmayacaksanız Kadıköy'de kalmak için başka yer aramaya gerek yok. Host oldukça kibar ve ilgili. Evin fiziksel özelliklerine gelirsem biraz daha bakımlı olabileceğini düşünüyorum, hijyen açısından bir sorunla karşılaşmadık ama gerek mobilyalar olsun gerek mutfak araç gereçleri eski ve bakımsız bir hissiyat verdi fotoğraftakilerin aksine. Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev oldukça temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Bulunduğu muhit sakin, güvenli ve ulaşım açısından da oldukça rahattı. Evde ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey düşünülmüş, genel olarak çok konforlu bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Ev sahibi de ilgili ve iletişim konusunda oldukça yardımcıydı. Gönül rahatlığıyla 5 yıldız veriyorum, tekrar yolumuz düşerse kesinlikle yeniden tercih ederiz. 🌟

Great value stay in the heart of Kadıköy.
The location is excellent, with plenty of things to enjoy within walking distance. The host was very kind, responsive, and communicated well, making sure all requests were handled smoothly. It’s an ideal place for solo travelers.
There are many pubs nearby, so it can be a bit noisy at night, but I highly recommend it for anyone who enjoys the lively Kadıköy vibe.

description:
Stay in the heart of Istanbul in this charming 1-bedroom apartment, just a 10-minute walk from Taksim Square. Enjoy easy access to historic landmarks, famous streets, nightlife, cafés, restaurants, and public transportation.

The apartment offers high ceilings, a comfortable living area, an almost fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, and fan. Located in a lively historic neighborhood, it is a perfect base for couples and solo travelers who want to experience authentic Istanbul.

reviews.text: Perfect little apartment at 15 min walk to Taksim square, in a quiet street, close to a small supermarket. It’s basic, but functional and exactly as described. Price-value-ratio is great. Fully functional kitchen, a small bathroom, and a separate bedroom facing another house which means it’s quiet. There are curtains everywhere which is great for shielding the light, however next to the bed they were a little short so light still came in. The best was the communication to the hosts - we got proactive and very clear information and lovely insider tips. Thank you again!

We had a wonderful stay! The location was perfect for our trip. The apartment is exactly as described—clean, cozy, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The best part was the host, who was so kind and helpful. They were always available and responded to messages instantly. We felt very well taken care of. Thank you for a great stay!

It is a cute small flat that has everything you’ll need for a short stay. The hosts were particularly lovely and responsive. The flat looked like in the pictures and it was very very clean there. A very nice option for such a price :)

The hosts were wonderful. Extremely helpful in getting to the place including going above and beyond in helping me with my bags. Very friendly and nice and gave helpful recommendations too.
The place itself was fine, but the bathroom is a little weird. It’s stuck into the bedroom in a way that leaves three feet above it and only 8 inches to the bed. Not possible to pass by the bathroom to the closet area without hopping over the bed. Also there is no room in the bathroom to put things and it smells a bit like mildew. Overall, not a luxury experience but fine.
Host is amazing, responsive and there to help if needed. The apartment is great, suitable for a long stay like mine was. Everything as described. Would love to stay here again. Thank you!

Accommodates up to 4 people
A comfortable stay in our large and spacious family room
The Istanbul experience awaits you. Our room has air conditioning, TV, fast internet, fridge, hair dryer and free tea-water-
Nescafe is provided. With its private bathroom and regular cleaning
Every detail has been considered to make our guests comfortable. An ideal accommodation alternative for families and groups of friends.

reviews.text:
The location is good, but this is not a boutique hotel. While the host was friendly and kind he told us the room would be ready at noon and it wasn’t ready until 2:30. We waited 45 minutes while he said “a few more minutes” over and over. If he had just let us know that it wouldn’t be ready until 2:30 we could have done something else with our time.
The linens and towels are clean, and the floor had just been mopped, but the furniture, paint, wiring of lights, everything was poorly done, falling apart, stained, etc. We came home from dinner and the floor in the bathroom was soaking wet- so when you shower water leeks from underneath the caulking on the floor.
For the price you can probably do much better, but this is okay. We felt safe and again the host was friendly and offered us coffee and tea and extra towels- but what they really need to do is invest a little, slowly by slowly if necessary, in having some proper contractors/carpenters/electricians.

We had a very pleasant stay here. The house is located right in the heart of Taksim, just steps away from Istiklal Street, with plenty of restaurants, shops, and cafés nearby. It’s also very convenient for public transportation, with easy access to buses and the metro, and close to major attractions in the Taksim and Istiklal area.
The host was really nice, welcoming, and accommodating. He was very flexible and understanding with both check-in and check-out, which we really appreciated. The room was good, clean, and comfortable, and everything we needed was provided.
The only inconvenience was the kitchen. The listing mentioned that there was a kitchen, but unfortunately, it is a very small kitchen shared by the whole building. So, if you are planning to cook your own meals during your stay, this may not be suitable for you.

The host was very helpful and welcoming. The location is great, just a few minutes' walk from Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue, making it super easy to explore the city. The accommodation was comfortable and clean.
The place is super clean and located in a vibrant neighborhood. The staff were super polite and responsive. I can surely recommend it! We enjoyed our night.

description: Situated in the energetic and modern district of Nisantasi is this large and stylishly decorated apartment. It boasts the highest quality furnishings and a unbeatable location, right in the heart of the city. The area is popular for its designer shopping and vast range of top quality restaurants and cafes.

reviews.text:
This was definetely our best AirBNB experience! The apartment and the host (Cem) exceeded our expectations.
Location is top, near the lively area of Nişantaşı, Teşvikiye. Very easy access to transport - metro station is just 3 min walk from the house. There are many shops and restaurants around, you can buy everything without leaving the area. We enjoyed the stay so much!
Cem is a great host and we became friends, he assisted us with any requests, helped with food deliveries, arranged everything. He even gave us complimentary wine and beers -you name it! He speaks fluent english.
The apartment was SUPER clean and cosy. It is very stylish and artistic. Everything is the same as shown in the photos. Everything u may need is provided - Kitchen staff, toiletries, big TV with netflix, good wifi..
We will definitely come back!

One of my favorite airbnbs that I’ve stayed in as a solo traveler. 🙏🏼
You have the comfortable space for 3 people if you need it. The vibe; you feel that you’re in an oasis, in a quiet space away from the chaos of Istanbul! Such attention to detail decorations, very clean and modern. I wish it wasn’t so nice because I didn’t want to leave; the bed is SO comfortable and place is soundproof, and the shades were incredible, I had the best sleep.
Location is unbeatable. Apartment is in a really quaint area, I always chose to stay in this neighborhood. Very safe and walking distance to shops, cafes, park etc. perfect for a solo female.
Cem is so friendly, responsive and hospitable! I really enjoyed getting to know him. The gym was why I initially booked this place, and I’m so glad I got to use the gym which is so convenient.
As people mentioned, yes you need to climb stairs to get here so caution that’s a concern but that’s also common here
I will 100 percent be back and stay here!

Our stay was good! The apartment is modern and located in a trendy neighborhood, which added to the overall experience. One of the major highlights for us was having access to the gym, even though it was located in a building adjacent to ours.
Pros:
- Spacious: The apartment impressed us with its generous size, boasting two terraces.
- The apartment was filled with natural sunlight, creating a pleasant ambiance.
- The recent renovations gave the apartment a contemporary and stylish look.
- AC was definitely a plus.
-Fast Wifi
Cons:
-4th-floor walk-up
- Lack of kitchen essentials: It would have been helpful to have kitchen essentials such as salt and pepper readily available.
- Noise during weekends: On weekends, it could get a bit noisy during the night.
- Cleaning needed in certain areas: While the overall cleanliness was satisfactory, some attention was required for cleaning the floors in particular.

This apartment is in a great location in upmarket Nisantasi as described online and is very comfortable and spacious. I stayed for a month and had very wonderful stay, with countless great restaurants, designer stores and supermarkets all within a 5 min walking radius of this apartment.

Cem, the host, who was raised in England, was very friendly and always accommodating. Any questions I had, Cem was more than willing to help and was an absolute pleasure to deal with.

An added bonus to this already great apartment, is the Gym which Cem runs. It is downstairs and free to use. It has only recently opened and has all the latest machines you need to work out.

The apartment is located within walking distance of the busy Besiktas, the Bosphorus and Taksim.

I cant recommend this apartment and Cem's hospitality more highly enough.

I had a great stay at Cem’s place in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Cem was a responsible and attentive host, always responsive and helpful whenever I needed anything. The location was also convenient, making my trip even more enjoyable. The only small suggestion I have is that some accessories, like the ironing board and iron, could be replaced with newer ones. Other than that, everything was great, and I would definitely recommend staying here!

description:
Located in the vibrant Yeldeğirmeni neighborhood of Kadıköy, our apartment is ideal for both short and long stays. The apartment is on the 2nd floor.

The living room is equipped with air conditioning and high-speed internet. Please note that the bedroom does not have air conditioning.

As the windows face the street, some street noise may be heard, especially during the day. Cafés, restaurants, markets, and public transportation are all within walking distance.

reviews.text:
Very clean and well-equipped Airbnb at a convenient location. The place looks exactly the same as it does in the pictures, but maybe a little smaller than it appears. The host is responsive, though we had a rough start due to the check-in time because we were informed that cleaning wouldn't be finished by check-in time. And we weren't happy about that, but luckily, they managed to finish cleaning on time and we were able to check-in exactly at 3pm.
Overall, a good Airbnb with very clean common spaces with great sound isolation and heating/cooling -- very much recommended.

I had stayed in a different Toosuites apartment before. This one was just as nice and functional. I like that one can predict that it will be very clean, it will have running water, comfortable heating, good wifi, etc.
The staff was very helpful when I had problems with my iPhone, it was a problem unrelated to the wifi in the apartment but caused by my own telecommunications company in my home country. Zeynep helped me by determining that in fact, it had nothing to do with Toosuites’ wifi so I could pursue resolving with my tel. company directly. Thanks again, Zeynep!

We had a great stay at TooSuites! The apartment had everything we needed and included great personal touches like a loofa, house slippers and a nice little sweet treat! The bed was comfy and the shower pressure was awesome! Extremely clean and still smelled brand new! It's located in a very walkable part of town with grocery stores, cafes and restaurants all at your door step.

Great little apartment in a heart of Asia side! It has everything you may wish and even more. Manager Zeynab was incredibly helpful, any of our requests were inmediately attended. Marmaray train staition and huge Carrefur is in about 10 min of an easy walking and smaller stores all are just around the corner. You don’t even need to cook as coffee shops etc are downstairs and at your full service. We had a great week in that house and are def recommending it!

Apartman yeni ve asansörlü. Daire de zevkli döşenmiş, eşyalar yeni ve rahat, temel ihtiyaçları karşılayacak eşyalar mevcut. Güvende ve rahat hissettiğiniz bir mekan. Aynı binada daha geniş bir dairede de kalmıştık, ona kıyasla bu daire biraz küçük ama iki kişi için yine de kalınabilecek bir daire. Konum olarak çok merkezi, etrafta birçok yemek yenilecek mekan, görülecek yer var. Ev sahibiyle kolayca iletişime geçip ihtiyaçlarınızı, sorularınızı iletip çözebilirsiniz. Giriş ve çıkış kolay olacak şekilde planlanmış, ekstra bir çaba gerektirmiyor. Herkese öneririm.

description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

reviews.text:
Good Good Good Here is a hotel review in English with around 1000 characters:
---
The hotel is quite good and offers a comfortable stay overall. The location is convenient, making it easy to access nearby attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. The room is clean and well maintained, with comfortable bedding and enough space to relax. Housekeeping does a good job of keeping everything tidy and organized.
The staff are friendly and helpful, always willing to assist with check-in, directions, or other requests. Their service makes guests feel welcome and well taken care of. The facilities are decent, including a clean bathroom, stable Wi-Fi, and basic amenities that meet daily needs.
Breakfast is satisfactory with a fair variety of food, suitable for different tastes. While the hotel may not be luxurious, it provides good value for the price paid. Overall, this hotel is a solid choice for travelers looking for a pleasant, affordable, and comfortable place to stay.

I had a great stay at this hotel near Galata Tower. The location was perfect—very central and within walking distance of many attractions, cafés, and restaurants.
The hotel has a 24/7 reception, which made everything very convenient, especially for late check-ins or if we needed any help during the night. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and always ready to assist.
The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Overall, it was a very pleasant experience and I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Istanbul. I would happily stay here again.

The place matched the photos and description, and the location is excellent, very close to Istiklal Street.
However, I would recommend this place more for guests with light luggage, as it felt a bit small for four people with large suitcases. The shower area is also quite compact, so it may be slightly uncomfortable when washing.
Additionally, there were no kitchen utensils provided, even though they were mentioned in the description.
Overall, the stay was good and the location was very convenient.

I loved the neighborhood and the proximity to local attractions. Unfortunately, the interior didn't live up to the location. The beds were very unstable and noisy during the night, which meant we couldn't sleep well. The host should consider upgrading the furniture to match the great location. And the shower needs fixing

Çalışanlar güler yüzlü yardım sever insanlardı. Oda renginden dolayı karanlıktı yataklar ömrünü doldurmuş çok rahatsızdı temizliğe biraz daha özen göstermeleri gerekiyor. Konumu Galata kulesine ve çarşıya yakındı. Sabah kahvaltısı fiyata dahildi ve uygundu.

description: Private 3-story home with two balconies and a mezzanine offering 180° panoramic Marmara views. Bright, artistic, and perfect for long stays. Wake up to sunlight and sweeping Marmara Sea views. The mezzanine offers a 180° panorama for reading or relaxing, and a cozy fireplace invites you to unwind on cooler evenings. Two balconies and spacious rooms make the entire house yours to enjoy in privacy. Designed by three generations of architects, it blends artistic character with comfort and charm.

reviews.text: The house is lovely and is located in beautiful surroundings with wonderful views. This was our second visit to the listing, the house requires some overall general maintenance and a deep clean. In the previous visit there was access to all facilities. As the host was living onsite this time he confirmed we should call him if we needed to use the washing machine which we were not comfortable with , if facilities are listed we should have access. This did somewhat affect our overall experience but only because we had different expectations based on the previous booking

The place is very beautiful and rich. It’s actually better than the pictures. The views are amazing. It’s very big. Ömer is kind and responsive.
I only had a small issue with cleanness. The kitchen tools weren’t clean and there was some dust in the rooms.

We had a fantastic stay at Ömer’s place in Heybeliada! Even though we stayed for just one day, we felt right at home.
Ömer was an incredible host with excellent communication, providing detailed check-in instructions and welcoming us warmly. Although the property looks small in photos, it is actually a beautiful 3-story house with a breathtaking panoramic sea view.
As an architect and designer, Ömer has decorated the place with exceptional taste—entering the house feels like stepping into a refined antique showcase. On top of that, he recommended a fantastic spot for dinner and even arranged food delivery for us when we called the restaurant.
Thank you, Ömer, for the wonderful hospitality! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Adalar.
Yatak ve kişisel alanlar gayet temiz sadece genel olarak konumdan dolayı veya evin büyüklüğünden kaynaklı hep bir tozlu gibi bir hissiyat veriyordu onun dışında her şey harikaydı çok memnun kaldık

Beautiful stay on a lovely island! We were greeted warmly by the host and felt right at home the moment we stepped in. The house is very charming and we loved all it's quirks, but the upstairs area with the view is truly the highlight! The island is a short and breathtaking ferry ride from the bustling city yet it's the perfect place for winding down and relaxing with one of the many interesting books you can find in the house. Definitely recommend!

description:
Located on the lively Istiklal Avenue, one of Istanbul's liveliest spots, our apartment stands out with its stylish and modern design. Located in a building with an elevator, the hotel offers a peaceful stay thanks to its soundproof structure that keeps the city noise out.
The apartment has a kitchen, washing machine and a seating area on the terrace, which is ideal for long stays. With its comfortable beds and modern decor, the apartment is perfectly suited for both short and long-term stays.

reviews.text:
A Lovely Stay at İnci Apartments
İnci Apartments is a comfortable place to stay right in the heart of the city. The apartment is clean and cozy, with a balcony and an elevator, which is really helpful after a long day of walking around.
The location is amazing — even closer than a short walk to İstiklal Avenue. Restaurants, cafés, and shops are literally just outside the door, with İnci Patisseries right downstairs for a quick treat. Taksim Square is also very close, and getting around is easy with the iconic red T1 Nostaljik Tramvay nearby.
Mehmet, the owner, is very helpful and responsive, making everything smooth and easy. One small note: there can be a bit of noise from nearby bars at night on the third floor, but it’s quite minimal.
Overall, it’s a lively, convenient, and enjoyable place to stay. Highly recommended.

We had a fantastic 2-night stay in this 1+1 apartment. The location in Taksim is unbeatable—tucked away enough to be quiet for sleeping but only a short walk from the vibrant energy of Istiklal Street and easy transit links.
The highlight was definitely the private terrace. It’s the perfect spot for a morning coffee or a glass of wine at night while soaking in the Istanbul skyline. The apartment itself was clean, modern, and well-designed; the separate living area made it feel much more spacious than a standard hotel room.
The host was very responsive, and the check-in process was easy. If you’re looking for a comfortable "home base" with a great outdoor space in the heart of the city, I highly recommend this spot!

Perfect location on Istiklal Street. The apartment was very clean and comfortable, with two bathrooms—great for families. Everything is nearby. Mehmet is a very kind and helpful host. Highly recommended!

Absolutely amazing stay! The apartment was spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, and looked exactly like the pictures. The location was perfect, close to everything we needed yet very peaceful. The host was incredibly helpful, polite, and quick to respond to any questions. They truly went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Highly recommend this place, and I will definitely stay here again

it is absolutly a good value for the stay, the balcony photos do not do the space justice, its so large. communication was amazing, everything was perfect. I will say takism is close to everything as well. crowded at times but worth it for convinience

description: Welcome to your modern and stylishly designed home, which is a few minutes away from Şişhane Metro, Tramway, Galata Tower, Tünel Square, İstiklal Avenue, Pera and GalataPort Cruise Port, and offers suite accommodation surrounded by restaurants, cafes, boutique shops and art galleries. With its fully equipped kitchen, large windows and spacious seating area, we offer an unforgettable city experience for our guests who want to feel the history of Istanbul, experience its energy and meet with comfort.

reviews.text:
We were happy with the Appartement. Location is pretty Mitch perfect with Metro, Ferry, Busses all in walking distance. Also the street is super private and you don’t get disturbed by street noice or loud people.
Only thing worth mentioning is that the flat was not spotless, water from the shower drained slowly and some moldy corners on the ceiling.
WiFi only 1.5 mb/s max all day.
Still I would recommend the place to people who want to explore Istanbul.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment was very clean and matched the description perfectly. The location is excellent, within walking distance of the main tourist attractions. A huge plus was the host's flexibility—they kindly allowed us to check in earlier since our flight arrived ahead of schedule. Highly recommended!
