description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. With 2 double beds, 1 baby crib and an L-shaped sofa set in front of the TV, a private garden where you will be comfortable with dining and a playground for children awaits you.

reviews.text: Mr. Aydın is a very responsible and trustworthy landlord. The apartment was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. He was always responsive and helpful whenever assistance was needed. I truly appreciate his professionalism and hospitality. Highly recommended for anyone looking to rent in Istanbul.

Host responded quickly and was understanding of the situation and allowed to checkout the next day after discovering the issues we ran into that were missing and not working properly unfortunately. Selection of amentities are key factors along with location for when choosing a place to stay for over a week. When they are missing, lacking and difficult to use, it is an uncomfortable stay.
1. Shower head is only a hand-held making it difficult to have a proper shower.
2. There were no blackout curtains at least in the bedroom and the kitchen only had a partial lacey curtain. Hallway is open to the kitchen where the back neighbors can see right in and you have to be fully clothesed to walk from bedroom to bathroom as it's in the hallway. Unless you shut the door. However, no AC other than in the living room, it was stuffy to shuts for airflow.
3. There was no dedicated workspace.
4. There was also no oven. We like to cook during long stays and roasting is a big factor in our meals.

I made the assumption that the apartment was on the ground floor because he said that kitchen open to a garden. But when I arrived, it was a narrow steep, dark unlit stairwell down to a sub level apartment. I can’t do stairs so I canceled. The host was very responsive and respectful and allowed me to cancel, but it still cost me a fee with Airbnb.

It was a great affordable stay, Aydin was so helpful with the checkin, the place is spacious and good for a family. Has all the amenities needed. And with an outdoor area.
Aydin also helped us with the transportations to the airport, which was so kind of him.
The apartment is close to all the historical sites and even to the public transportations if you want to explore farther places in Istanbul.
I recommend it!

Aydin is not only a host he told me you are like my brother, very cooperative, kind , helpful , quick responsive, perfect guide, If you find any problems in flat , get fixes it asap.
I never seen host like him in 20 years travellinghistory......salute to you my brother, stay healthy and keep loving your guests
Regards

description:
From the moment you step outside this venue, you'll find everything you've been waiting to discover.
Sultanahmet is 50 meters away.
Hagia Sophia is 100 meters away.
Horse Square is 30 meters away.
All similar attractions are just 300 meters away.

reviews.text:
very friendly and responsive host, Turgut.
I'll strongly recommend place if you're wishing to explore Blue mosque, aya sofiya, topkapi palace and lots more nearby. there's a common kitchen as well which includes almost everything you need to cook anything, even basic ingredients and spices. This place also have a terrace where you can get beautiful view of see and surroundings as well. Host has his own restaurant at ground floor, they offer very tasty and good food at reasonable prices delivered at your door.

Very good place to stay in Istanbul. Super central but quiet at night. Everything was just like in the photos. Check-in was also very easy and straightforward. The only small downside was the hot water — in the evening it stayed hot only for a few seconds, but in the mornings it was fine.

We stayed in room 7. The accommodation is located in a great neighbourhood. All major attractions like blue mosque, Hagia Sofia, grand bazar is at walking distance. The property was neat and clear and the host is very friendly, respectful and responsive. The communication from the host was very clear. We really enjoyed our stay and great value for money.

I was looking for accommodation just a week before my arrival, and this was likely the best option available at the time. The price and quality were a perfect match, and the location was absolutely ideal—I could walk to everything I needed, and the tram was just a three-minute walk away. Yes, the place isn't new—you can tell it hasn't been renovated in a long time, and it wasn't perfectly clean—but for the price, it was fine by me. If you're on a tight budget, I’d recommend this place. The owner also offers a discount at his restaurant, and a special shout-out to the staff—the service was outstanding. Thanks for the hospitality.
Best location, amazing host, very hospitable. everything is a walking distance, place is clean, i definitely recommend.

description: Located right behind Istanbul's famous Galata Tower this apartment offers amazing views and a comfortable stay. It has a big rooftop terrace with stunning Bosphorus & the old city views. The apartment is 5 mins to tram, metro, bus and ferry stations.This tastefully decorated place has 3 seperate bedrooms and can accomodate up to 8 people. You can access almost all major tourist attractions and sites by walk from the apartment. There are plenty of nice restaurants,bars and cafes around!

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and I highly recommend this apartment. It was very clean, comfortable, and the location is excellent, right in the center with the main attractions within walking distance.
There is a paid parking lot only about a 4-minute walk away, and we were even able to park our minivan there. However, driving around the Old City can be quite difficult, so I would recommend using taxis instead. We barely needed our car because most of the main attractions were within walking distance.
One of our favorite features was the rooftop terrace. It is a beautiful place to watch the sunrise or sunset with an amazing view of the city and the Bosphorus.
The rooms and towels were very clean, the beds were comfortable, and the Wi-Fi was excellent. There is one king-size bed. The refrigerator was spotless, and everything we needed was provided, including shampoo, laundry detergent, and dishwasher detergent. There is air conditioning only in the living room, but this was not an issue

We really enjoyed our time in Istanbul even before arrival, thanks to the friendly communication with the host. We were greeted warmly as we got out of the taxi and shown everything in the apartment, and the surrounding from the terrace.
The beds are comfortable and had beautiful clean sheets.
We enjoyed the street noise at night - the apartment is central, in a lively area and you can walk to a lot of places we wanted to see. A fantastic experience and just what we we wanted!
great location, we enjoyed our time there. flat was clean, beds comfortable and host was responsive and helpful. removing a bit of clutter from drawers would be a minor improvement. thank you

This is the best apartment in the Istanbul area.
We were amazed by the view from the rooftop terrace⭐️⭐️⭐️
It has a perfect location right next to the Galata Tower.
The tram, ferry pier and metro are just a few steps away.
The kitchen is fully equipped and the apartment is very comfortable. Thank you so much for hosting us ☺️

During my stay there was an issue with the table which fell off the wall and it was fixed but communication about it could have been better. Overall recommended apartment though!
Very good location and apartment. We really enjoyed staying there, all the necessary kitchen equipment was there, bed sheets were clean, and the towels were clean. Recommended this apartment!

Everything was as expected nothing special. Just be awareness of taking photos before entering and before leaving this place (share them with the admins), they might charge you for damages that you didn’t even caused. That’s all. Other than that It is just like in the photos.

description:
☀️ Welcome to our Yellow Room ☀️

Bathed in soft shades of yellow, this room was designed to feel warm, peaceful, and genuinely welcoming, a place where you can slow down and feel at home.

Located in a beautifully restored historic building, our Yellow Room offers a stunning view of the Galata Tower, right in the historic heart of Istanbul. Step out onto the spacious balcony, breathe in the city’s rhythm, and enjoy a moment just for yourself.

Our Yellow Room is ready to welcome you. ✨

reviews.text:
The location is literally right next to Galata Tower. I was shocked at how close it was. My only concern was that it might be noisy, but somehow both the street and the bedroom are quiet. You would have no idea that, just a few meters away, the area is packed with people.
The unit is recently renovated, and everything felt brand new. The host responded very quickly to any questions or concerns I had. The bed is very comfortable, which is sometimes rare in Istanbul, since beds tend to be firmer.
There was no elevator, which is common in Turkey. There is also a nice coffee shop below where you can get food or work on your laptop.

We loved staying here it was neat and well equipped. Galata tower is just few steps away from this Airbnb. Sishane metro station is nearby for sure a little walk is must in Istanbul but it’s still very nearby. The cafe down has amazing breakfast. Accessible to almost every popular look outs. We would love to come back had a wonderful stay and super host 😊

Despite being in a very central location, Galata Hive was surprisingly quiet at night, allowing me to sleep comfortably throughout my stay. It offers easy access to almost every major attraction and public transportation. The property was clean, well-maintained, and organized, making it a comfortable and enjoyable place to stay. I would happily stay here again.
Nice comfortable and clean place in a great location for getting around!

This is a great location for a stay in istanbul! The host is very communicative/responsive, and helped arrange transfers to and from the airport for me. Abdullah and Metin has been great hosts as they are always responsive and flexible. The apartment was exactly as they promised and a great location to visit all the known touristy areas. Also it was inside the street so it was peaceful at night. So definitely recommend their place.

description: Welcome to our modern 1-bedroom apartment in the heart of Sultanahmet, Istanbul's historic center. Located just 1 minute from Hagia Sophia and only a short walk from the Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar, and the T1 tram station, you'll be perfectly positioned to explore the city's most famous attractions.

reviews.text:
Great location but not worth it. Upon arrival things looked tidy, but upon closer inspection it was extremely dirty. The bathroom was so gross we avoided using as much as possible. The toilet seat was broken and we wondered why host felt this was ready for us.
Listed as able to host 4, we had three and it was tight. AC did not work in livingroom area where one of us had to sleep. We asked for it to be addressed and it wasn't. There were multiple things that were not functional and took extended time to address. Very steep stairs to get in and out. Over all would say it is great for 1-2 young people who just need a place to crash or two adults who can sleep in bedroom that had an AC that worked well.
Nice being close to Ayia Sofia but early morning prayers woke us up : especially since person sleeping in livingroom had to keep windows open to allow for cooler air through the night.
This was our first nights after traveling fromUSA and in hindsight, a quieter area may have been best.

Perfect location and size of apartment for the two of us for a 6 night stay. Walking distance for Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Harem Museum, Basilica Cistern, Grand Bazaar & Spice Bazaar. We arranged transport with Airbnb host from airport to apartment. Host’s brother met us and brought our luggage up one flight of stairs. He showed us around and showed us shared clothes washing machine on ground floor near entrance door. Refrigerator, microwave & dishes were perfect for take away leftovers from the many restaurants in area as portions were large. Bed comfortable, shower large with plenty of warm water. We figured out the TV and watched Netflix. We got our cappuccinos every morning across the street at Anadolu Coffee House opens 7 AM. A very nice stay and would stay again.

We booked 3 nights for 2 adults and 2 teenagers. This is a 1 bedroom apartment on 2nd floor of the building. Beside the double bed in the bedroom, there are 02 sofa beds in the living room.
It’s location can beat everything, walkable to almost main attractions in the old quarter and its near Gulhane T1 Tram. We arrive a bit early before official check in time (2pm) but the owner still allow us early check in. There are plenty of food options around the area, Kitchen is equiped with electrict stoves, microwave oven, air fryer…
There is no hot water when ee areive but then Yavuz fixed it.
We enjoy our stay in this apartment

We stayed at this property from 7th to 10th June and had a very pleasant experience. The location is excellent, making it easy to visit many famous attractions using public transportation such as buses, trams, and trains.
The host was very friendly and understanding. We arrived earlier than our scheduled check-in time, and he kindly allowed us to check in 2 hours early, which we really appreciated.
The property is clean, comfortable, and very budget-friendly. There are plenty of restaurants, cafes, and supermarkets within walking distance, making it very convenient for travelers.
Overall, we had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for an affordable and well-located accommodation.

Was a wonderful location with a balcony view of Hagia Sophia. Host was very helpful and communicated well… assisted us with airport transfers and any questions we had.
Apartment had plenty of room… good sized bedroom, kitchen with appliances and two couches which were welcome after long days walking around and exploring.

description:

reviews.text:
The hosts were incredibly friendly, helpful, and responsive throughout our stay! We were a group of 7 and stayed for a full week.
The apartment is on the first floor, up 1 flight of stairs, and the building does not have an elevator, which is worth keeping in mind if you have heavy luggage.
One thing to note is that there are two AC units, both located in bedrooms at opposite ends of the apartment. We were able to keep the apartment comfortable by leaving the bedroom doors open, but if you prefer to sleep with the doors closed, the living room and other areas can get quite warm.
The kitchen has a fridge but no freezer. This ended up being important for us because my mom had brought some goodies that needed to stay frozen. The host was very kind and offered to keep them in the freezer in his own home, which we really appreciated!
The location truly couldn’t be better, it was one of the highlights of our stay! Overall, we had a great experience and I would definitely stay here again!

The apartment was exactly as described and worked well for our group of 7. One bedroom and bathroom are at the end of the hall and felt private, separated by the kitchen and other bathroom in the hall from the other bedrooms and living room.
The location was very convenient, and we found some good eateries and shops nearby. Everything was clean and comfortable. I’d definitely stay here again if visiting Istanbul especially if I wanted to be near Taksim or a short trip to Sultanahmet.
Nevzat was very responsive and made sure to answer any questions I had before and during our stay.

We had an amazing time staying at Nevzat’s place. It was very spacious and extremely clean. He was extremely responsive and helped with any issues we had. Our only issues with the place where that construction was going on outside during our stay and the Wi-Fi did not work while we were there. I would imagine these issues will not continue but was just unfortunate timing. Overall, we loved the place and the location. We had a great time staying there and enjoying Istanbul!
We had a great stay! The apartment is beautiful, located in a vibrant neighbourhood and close to the train. Everything was as described! Communication was smooth and easy.

Thank you Nevzat, such a helpful host, easy communication through Wtsapp message and he is very responsive. The area of the apartment has cute souvenir shop and walking distance from popular streets. The only downside is that the building is under construction during my stay, it’s not noisy and not disturbing at night, but the construction smell is strong. Still recommend apartment tho!

description: It is a private room with a bathroom, air conditioning, TV, tea and coffee for the room in a central location. There is no shared use. There is also the possibility of late-night check-in. The bed is a double bed, and it is slightly narrower than regular beds. You can sleep comfortably as a couple. It is a small but spacious room overlooking the backyard. If there is anything you're curious about, you can always message and ask.

reviews.text:
All in all, I would say the place was not great. Bear in mind that apartment is tiny, you don't have much space, but I guess that's what you get for that price since apartment/hotel prices in Istanbul is extremely inflated relative to it's GDP. The roomwas fairly clean, but sink in bathroom was completely clogged, so I couldn't use it at all, so I used shower room for everything.
Unless you're very tight on budget, I wouldn't recommend the place.
Great location very clean room and cozy! Alihan was welcoming, available and helpful.I greatly recommend this hotel!

Amazing location!!! Close to the Hagia Sofia and "Blue Mosque". The hotel organized my trip to and from the airport as well as a guided tour of the city which was helpful. Alihan was very accommodating and helpful both before and during the trip. A lot of restaurants very close to this location.

Alihan's place was a wonderful experience for me. Personally I went to explore the city for majority of the day and I'd come back to a clean and comfortable room every night! Breakfast was delicious and there was always someone available to help if needed. There was no electricity in the neighborhood the first night I was there, however having a candlelit night positively added to the experience of the trip!

I highly recommend staying here. You cannot beat the value for money. The location is amazing. Walking distance to all the big attractions such as Aya Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilicata Cistern and so on. I really enjoyed my stay here. Thank you for being a great host.

description: Located in the heart of Kadıköy, our apartment is just a 3-minute walk from the iconic Bull Statue. Kadıköy Ferry Terminal and the M4 Metro are 5 minutes away, while Marmaray and the Metrobus are about a 10-minute walk. Moda Seaside, Bar Street, cafés, restaurants, boutique shops, markets, and cultural attractions are all within walking distance. After exploring the city, relax in a bright, spacious, and thoughtfully designed home.

reviews.text: my stay was amazing! the location is super accessible and literally everything major is around kadikoy is around you! the house is comfortable, the rooms are spacious and clean, the kitties are adorable!! super worth the stay 🌟 the host is amazing at communicating with you and super helpful! 💕

Gizem was an amazing host and made me feel welcome from the very first moment. She is incredibly kind, friendly, and easy to talk to. We had lovely conversations, and I truly felt more like I was staying with a friend than at an Airbnb. She even surprised me with a delicious cup of coffee and toast one morning, which was such a thoughtful gesture and made me feel right at home. The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I really enjoyed my stay and would happily stay with Gizem again on my next visit to Istanbul. Thank you for everything! ❤️

Gizem is a perfect host. She was very welcoming and made my stay so comfortable. Communication was also very easy.
The house was spotless, and the room was very comfy, exactly as shown in the pictures. The location is very central, with easy access to all kinds of public transportation.
I had a wonderful stay. Thank you, Gizem, for your hospitality!

Gizemm was a great host and the location is superb. It’s situated in a more local area rather than a typical tourist spot, which I really enjoyed. There are plenty of affordable food options nearby as well. Ferry, tram, metro and bus just minutes away.
The only downside is that you will need to keep the windows closed at night as there’s a bar and club downstairs that can get quite noisy. Other than that, everything was perfect. I would definitely recommend staying here!

I stayed one night at the Gizemm’s home located very center area of kadikoy.
Room was clean and cozy, there were very cute two cats.
Since it is located very central area, it can be little noisy at night. But it way okay for me.

description:
LOCATION:

The flat is in a historical building situated in the Galata area close to Istiklal Avenue that takes you through the heart of Istanbul's commercial and entertainment Pedestrian Boulevard, leading to the famous Taksim Square.
Central for all travel connections. (i.e. 5 minutes walk to the conventional ferries, tramway and Şişhane subway station.)
Less than 10 minutes by tram to get to the old city (i.e. Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, several historical turkish baths, Grand Bazaar)
2 minutes walk to Istiklal Avenue

10 minutes walk to the Spiced/Egyptian Bazaar

reviews.text:
We were a group of colleagues stopping Istanbul before heading to a conference in Izmir and Fatih's place was perfect for our needs!!!!
The neighborhood it's situated in is near Galata tower and was probably my favorite area of Istanbul. There was a mix of both tourists in the area and I loved how we weren't being hassled by restauranteurs and/or shop owners like we were in the more touristy areas of Istanbul.
We were really close to everything by either walking, metro, or subway (all very cheap!) Fatih was even kind enough to arrange us a ride to and from the airport at a very reasonable rate!
The place itself was lovely. We had clean bedding, towels and even dishes and cookware in the apartment. The hot water was awesome as well! This place worked very well for our group of 5.
Faith is a very kind host and even took the time to give us a map and tell us where we should go and how we should get there. You should have no reservations staying with Fatih! If I come to visit Istanbul again I would definitely stay at his apartment!!

Fatih was a great host. Welcome us with fruits and drinks, guide us through the city, answered all of our questions. Do not he site to ask his opinion. He saved us a couple of time! Apartment is great, clean and very well located. It is spacious and well furnished. Huge bathroom, no AC but enough fans to work it out. When in Istanbul, THIS IS the place to stay. Thanks again Fatih for making our stay memorable. Highly recommended host!

Fatih is a gracious host; he met us at the apartment, helped us with our bags, held the baby while we got organized, made us coffee, and helped with ideas for where to explore in Istanbul, since it wasn't our first visit. He also arranged a van pick-up to and from the airport, which was a huge help for our group, which included two small kids. The apartment itself is perfectly situated, just down the street from Galata tower, a short walk from the tram, and surrounded by great places to eat or to have a coffee. The only drawback s a bit of noise from the upstairs neighbors, but it didn't prevent anyone in our crew from sleeping/napping! Fatih's place is a great choice.

Location was fantastic, situated right by the Galata tower which made it easy to find the way home from anywhere in Istanbul. Walking distance to just about everything from Taksim to Sultanahmet. The apartment itself exceeded expectations. Very clean and tidy. Make us feel at home. Fatih was a great host, setting up transportation and providing suggestions for restaurants and things to do. He was also very quick with replying to emails before and during our time in Istanbul. This was our first AirBnB experience and couldn't have been more pleased.

This is a delightful comfortable historic flat in an excellent location full of atmosphere and history. Fatih is an outstanding host- available but not intrusive, a great communicator and full of helpful advice. Wholeheartedly recommended.

description:
Greetings!
This is a reverse duplex Microstudio Apartment(20m²).
It's a perfect choise for has a minimal lifestyle and wants to live with less.
The apartment has one bedroom with a double bed(140x190cm) which is located downstairs.

reviews.text:
I spent 4 days (3 nights) at Arjens apartment in Istanbul with my girlfriend. Arjen was there to welcome us and show us the apartment even if we was 15-20 min late. He had a big smile and the good will to explain everything and answer toour questions.
The apartment was just like the photos, perfectly clean and exactly what you need for a short stay in Istanbul. When you open the door is the kitchen and the redecorated bathroom. You go down the stairs and you will find a comfortable double bed and enough space to leave your staff. The hole space is not huge but is enough for two persons.
The apartment's location is perfect. 3-5 min from Sishane Metro station and Tophane Tram station. That makes it perfect to move whenever you like. Just where Sishane is, the Istiklal road starts who is full of stores restaurants and cages and leads to Taksim square. Galata toweris just 5-7 min walk and the hole neighbour has an alternative-hipster atmosphere with a lot of cafes and shops in that mood.
We loved our stay at Arjen's Airbnb and I definitely recomend it if you want to be in the heart of Istanbul for a few nights.
P.S. Arjen's apartment is not suitable for disabled people because the neighbour has a lot of stairs and climbs and the apartment has a round stair to go downstairsto the bedroom.

Great location! Nice neighborhood, you can reach almost everything on foot plus its close to the metro and the tram station. Communication with Arjen was excellent and the check-in instructions very detailed. The room is clean, however very small. The first floor has a little kitchen and the toilet and downstairs through a very small staircase you will find the bedroom. It may feel tight for two people and stuffy from humidity from time to time.

It was super small and wasn’t as good as it looks at the pictures. The bathroom is the biggest problem, it doesn’t have a shower cabin and the whole bathroom floods when you want to have shower. One time it flood so much, the water came down to the bed downstairs, it was like heavy rain indoors!! Plus the window doesn’t close so it’s gonna be a show to the neighbors while you are taking shower! It must improve and solve this problems indoors, even though it’s a clean and nicely located apartment, because of the bathroom we couldn’t enjoy our stay much :(

Konum harika. Galata’ya çok yakın. Çarşaflar ve havlular çok temizdi. Aynı şekilde mutfak banyo da temizdi. Yatak odasında wifi bazen çekmiyordu ve telefon da çekmiyor. Üst katta sıkıntı yok fakat altta biraz problem oldu. Ev çevresi sessiz gürültü yoktu. Bu fiyata bu konumda ev fiyat performans olarak çok iyi.

Very nice for a few nights and good location. It felt smaller than the pictures and hard to get up and down the narrow staircase. The water for the building went out and came back brown although this was a general problem and the hosts' fault. Overall good value for a short city break.

description: Very calm and quite flat can be this much close to very animated down town of Üsküdar

reviews.text:
BEST PLACE YOU CAN FIND THIS NEAR THE CENTER IN ÜSKÜDAR WITH SUCH A PRICE.
Murat is a great host, always ready to answer any queries..
The house is as shown in the pictures.
It was clean and with all necessary equipment, even for staying longer than just a few days.
It is located very close to everything you need; grocery market, Üsküdar center, bars, restaurants, etc. You get used to the soft hill after the first time. The neighborhood is absolutely quiet, too.
Would recommend it to anyone and will be comming back myself.

Murat was a great host. Very helpful. The place has hot water, is comfortable, and best of all, its close to a great area. We stayed 3 months and it became a second home. vegetable seller 2 minutes away, and a fresh pastry/bread shop as well. Its a 150 steps to a small well-cared for masjed for all 5 prayers, another 2 minutes walk after that and you're at a beautiful old Domed breathtaking Masjed. Another one of those 5 min after that. A butcher shop and grocery with in 3 minutes of walking. At the bottom of the hill (7 min of walking) - and its not a bad hill. (believe me...there are some CRAZY hills in Istanbul, and you are at one of the best restaurant and coffee/pastry cafes streets around, and another even bigger ancient domed Mosque. Another one of these 3 minutes after that. You can get to a mall even by walking. (Takes about 15 minutes, and is easier going there than coming back, but even the hill coming back was doeable for my 8 month pregnant wife. Its just a great area.

We had a wonderful stay at Murat's place in Uskudar, Istanbul. Murat was very helpful, welcoming, and always available when needed. The apartment was clean, tidy, and well-maintained.
Everything we needed was easily accessible, and we especially appreciated the thoughtful touches such as napkins, salt, sugar, coffee, and other basic essentials that made us feel at home.
We are leaving Istanbul with great memories, and Murat's hospitality played a big part in that experience. Thank you, Murat, for your kindness and support throughout our stay.
I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Murat bey ilgili ve yardımsever bir ev sahibi. Kendisi tüm sorulara hızlı yanıt verdi giriş ve çıkış saati konusunda yardımcı oldu. Ev güvenli bir semtte marmaray ve iskeleye yakın. Kız kulesine de yürüme mesafesinde. Güvenli ve huzurlu bir konaklama için Murat Bey’ in evini öneririm.
Ev fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibidir.

We really enjoyed our stay here, it was a great location near to ferries, metro, and busses, with tons of cute cafes and restaurants in walking distance. The neighborhood was very peaceful and quiet. Our host was extremely accommodating with an early check-in and a late checkout, which helped us so much because of when our flights arrived and departed, he always responded quickly to any questions we had, and was very friendly. If we get the chance to visit Istanbul again I wouldn’t hesitate to rebook.

reviews.text: The house is very cozy, big living room, good furniture, everything was exactly like in photos, great location and near metro, Abdullah was very helpful and kind, we definitely will book again for next trip to Istanbul, we had a great time, Thank you!
The nicest host. Communication nice and easy. Very helpful in all aspects. The apartment has spacious living room and furniture is new and comfortable. Location is central in a calm neighborhood.

Great apartment. It is in the perfect location - just far enough from the noisy streets so it is quiet, yet close enough that a very short walk brings you to everything. the space is very nice with super comfortable furniture. Abdullah was kind enough to pre-stock water and a snack inside, too!
Extended my stay here a second time as I felt extremely comfortable and communication is fast and cordial. Great value for money!

Burcu and Abdullah are very accommodating and helpful, central heating was not on when we arrived, but Abdullah ordered a heater quickly and it got delivered to us the next day.
The place is great and central, close to major tourist attractions.
The apartment was not as clean as we expected, yet overall we had a good time staying there for two weeks.
Thank you very much Burcu and Abdullah, hope to see you again!

description:
Modernly decorated two rooms, one living room, two bathrooms and a jacuzzi
an apartment

reviews.text:
The host answered late the message on how to get the key. The apartment did not look like the photos we saw (it did not have a bathtub or jacuzzi and dryer) the first day the house was not clean. There were cockroaches in the apartment.
Location is perfect and easy access to public transport , shopping center and restaurants .

Everything’s was good so far, but we didn’t had wifi in the first week, and during the lockdown, forced to be home without internet or any non Turkish tv option rly sucks, they’ve send a man to correct it but he came 4 times, and he couldn’t do it, the 5 time it worked
Pros: Nice looking flat , nearby to mall and station, it’s clean and big and had 8 beds even if we just used one lol
Konaklamamizdan gayet memnun kaldik. Evin konumu cok guzel, ev temizdi.
Very safe (outside keypad door). Very close to the Metro and bus routes. Very clean. Excellent confectionary store just 5 doors south. We stopped every night!
Gayet iyi bir ev gerek konum olsun gerek ev sahibi.

description:
This newly renovated 2 bedroom (170sq) flat is purposely built for travellers to feel at home!

The flat offers a fully equipped kitchen with large dining space and living room (with a huge TV) and balcony.

Its perfectly located for guests looking to be close to shopping and restaurants.

Situated a stroll away from the high end shopping district of Istanbul; Nisantasi and the metro station ; Osmanbey; where you can easily reach the Old Town of Istanbul; Taksim.

reviews.text: This place offers incredible value for the price. The location is excellent and highly walkable, with the metro just a 2-minute walk away. The apartment is exactly as advertised; clean, spacious, and equipped with plenty of storage space and a well-stocked kitchen. The balcony provides a nice view of the street and city life. The owner was very responsive to all my requests. I highly recommend staying here.

I had an incredible experience staying in this flat during my recent trip to Istanbul. The flat itself was clean, spacious, and featured a fantastic open floor plan that made it feel even larger. The elevator access was especially convenient, and it really added to the overall comfort of the stay.
The host was responsive and made sure everything was perfect for my stay. I highly recommend this flat to anyone looking for a combination of modern living and a prime location in Istanbul. I can’t wait to come back!

Pros: - extremely convenient area with walkable neighborhood and 5 min walk to metro. Unlike other areas of Istanbul, this area is truly walkable as their are not a lot of hills.
- we were traveling with twin 9 month olds and needed baby beds which he provided brand new- the quality was better than expected and so appreciated. He also allowed us to ship high chairs in advance.
- comfortable beds and furniture
- the place is actually bigger/better than it appears in photos
- despite being in a central location, there was not much street noise
- there are many good coffee shops and restaurants nearby!
- this place has a washer and dryer which is rare
Cons- the kitchen could be better equipped- however, the owner lives nearby and let us take extra things from his flat.
- the owner was not responsive on our arrival day which was super stressful! We waited in the street for a half hour after texting and calling dozens of times to let him know our flight arrived.

The apartment was gorgeous. It was a bit difficult to locate at check-in but i messaged the host who gave really accurate directions and it turned o it to be in a really accessible location.
So many nice shops and cafes around. A lot of transportation options too. And I had a very comfortable sleep in the double room. I would highly recommend this place.

The issues mentioned in the other reviews are all true: paint is peeling off the walls, door knobs and sockets are loose, and the neighbourhood is noisy.
Despite this, the location is excellent and the house is quite livable. Potential improvements could be as follows:
- A clear non tinted full length mirror
- improvement of fixtures such as sockets and door knobs.
- Better mattresses and pillows, the current ones are a bit thin and worn out.
-Inclusion of house keeping services.
-Welcome basket that includes essentials like soap and drinking water.
-Some of the furniture is slightly damaged and can be improved.
- A better more modern TV.
However the house is very livable and everything was clean and usable when we stayed there. The noise levels are relatively easy to ignore unless you have very young kids.
Generally great location and we didnt have any trouble or major inconvenience in our time there.

description: Floors are on the right and left side of the custom hardwood floor mattress, night light available, tv in the bedroom, sofa bed in the middle acting as a bed, mini fridge and kitchen tea set, electric cooker available.

reviews.text: The location is very central, easy to reach via public transportation and many interesting sights are walkable. The communication was fast and it was easy to find the location of the cafe, where the apartments are located above. The personnel of the cafe are very friendly, responsive and helpful. The food was also good. However, as most of the services in Istanbul it was overpriced. The rooms and shower were not completely cleaned, I had to do it myself to assure it fits my expectations. Quite often during the day the water supply was shut down for around an hour, one time the Internet was off. the explanation was that the whole district of Istanbul was facing it, not what you expect in 21 century in a centre of a metropole, while paying services as a 3\4 star hotel in Europe. Appropriate air ventilation system is missing in the building, so the smoke from the cafe downstairs gets into all rooms and all your clothes with the time. It's being smoked everywhere in Istanbul, a sad thing.

I visited with my mother. Host is very very kind and friendly person. Always up for help and good laugh. One room with king size bed tv and ac and couch. Other room with two single bed and small counter for fridge.
Bathroom need bit tidy in a sense of new marble , may be bit of paint ( it wasn’t dirty ) water pressure very good. Lift to go on floors we were on floor 3.
Towels , bed sheets all linen clean. I couldn’t find iron so I asked host and within mint he arranged it. All you need to tell host what u need and he make sure he provide that. Very walkable to tram station. Literally 5-10 walk to blue mosque and aya sofia.
Best part is Host , he make u feel so good always very respectfull and go out of his way to help you.
It’s very good for family I enjoyed my stay and defo I ll b returning to this place again soon

We had a lovely stay at Bayram's apartment. The apartment was exactly what we expected and as we saw on the photographs. The location is fantastic, near to all Istanbul main attraction, near to public transport, excellent restaurants, cafés, all types of shops. Bayram's café itself is really comfortable and we decided to have breakfast there every day instead of eating elsewhere. The most important thing to mention, Bayram and all of the staff at the café where very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended.

Very hospitable
and warm people. As soon as we arrived, we were treated to the most delicious apple tea we've had in all of Istanbul, and of course we also took a package to take home. They agreed to let us check in before 1pm in the apartment and also stored our luggage on the last day until it was time for our train.
Everyone was polite and accommodating. We were treated to local delicacies - milk with rice and semolina halva.
Great location, close to the Bosphorus and well priced restaurants.
If we visit Istanbul again, we would choose the same place.

Die Unterkunft hat eine super Location. Es ist sehr nah an vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten. Die Verbindung zu den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sind sehr gut. Die nächste Straßenbahn, Metro oder Marmaray ist in wenigen Gehminuten zu erreichen! Tolle Einkaufsmöglichkeiten. Kleiner Supermarkt direkt in der Nähe und sehr leckere Restaurants in der Straße!
Die Unterkunft war für den Preis okay. Es bedarf aber dringlich einer Renovierung und etwas mehr an Sauberkeit. Die Handtücher und Bettbezüge waren jedoch ausreichend sauber.
Wir wurden sehr herzlich begrüßt. Wir haben uns sehr sicher gefühlt. Bei Fragen und Bedürfnisse hatte wir 24/7 ein Ansprechpartner, da sich die Unterkunft über dem Café des Besitzers befindet und dieser nie schließt.

description:
✨ A Stylish and Comfortable Escape in the Heart of the City

Located in the heart of Şişli, just 5-7 minutes from the metro, our modern 1+1 apartment is within walking distance of Nişantaşı's luxury shops, cafes, and elegant streets.

With its elegant design, fully equipped kitchen, and city views, combine the comfort of home with the dynamism of Istanbul.

Whether you're here to explore or relax, this place offers the perfect Istanbul accommodation experience.

reviews.text:
Kaan bey ve yardımcısı Arif bey sorulara hemen yanıt verdi ve taleplerimizi karşıladı. Ev ana caddeye çok yakın. Civarda market, restoran, eczane ve diğer her türden mekan bulunuyor. Osmanbey metro istasyonu yürüyerek 8 dakika uzaklıkta.
Yatak ve kanepeler rahattı. Banyo yeterli büyüklükte ve temizdi. Smart TV, Wi-Fi ve kalorifer sorunsuz çalışıyordu.
Evin hemen karşısında 24 saat açık ücretli otopark var. Evin bulunduğu muhit güvenli görünüyor.

Awesome place to stay!!! Close to shopping, restaurants, the subway . Everywhere in walking distance.. the BNB is very clean, comfortable, roomy . The host was quick to respond to any questions , things that we needed like fresh towels , laundry , trash pickup . Very enjoyable stay !
The place was very clean and tidy. Kaan is helpful and responsive. The apartment is 10 minutes walk to osmanbey metro station and a lot of bus stops nearby. Great location and great place

Kaan is a great host.
We loved this place a lot, felt there like at home.
Very comfortable, clean, with all needed stuff. Our dog was happy here as well.
The area is pretty good with a lot of pizza places, supermarkets, and Starbucks not far from the home.
Highly recommended if you are in Istanbul.

Konum olarak çok güzel yerde çok merkezi bir lokasyon ev sahibi kaan bey gerçekten çok ilgilendi konuk severliğine hayran kaldım arif bey’e çok tşk ederim ihtiyaçlarımız doğrultusunda çok yardımcı oldular kesinlikle şiddetle tavsiye ediyorum çok temiz hijyenik bir teşekkür ederim kaan bey temizlik kiti ve bana özel olarak ayarlanan sepet için bile çok teşekkür ediyorum
Very nice location, very central location, the host was really interested in the hospitality I was fascinated by the hospitality. Thank you very much for the basket set

description:
The hotel is ideally located in 150 meters to Taksim Square. Just in two minutes walk you'll be right in the Istiklal Avenue and enjoy Turkish restaurants serving traditional food, gorgeous boutiques,art galleries,historical buildings, cafes, pubs,night clubs,live music etc.
You will have a view of Beyoglu in a vibrant area of Istanbul in your private terrace.

reviews.text:
The host was super nice upon checkin and very helpful when we had questions. Also location wise it’s excellent if you want to explore the city. It’s very close to Taksim.
However, we were not satisfied with the cleanliness of the room. Our bedsheet had a whole in it and both our pillows had yellow stains. When we wanted to use the kettle the smell when opening it was unbearable. It was burning in our eyes. Really don’t know what was inside of it but we didn’t touch it for the rest of the stay. All in all, a decent place to stay if you don’t want to spend too much on accommodation.

Located close to a great area in taksim, and Mehmet is a lovely host. The bed sheets and towels were a bit worn and it was hard to escape the neighborhood smell, but overall a nice spot to stay for a short visit.
the room turned out to be a little smaller than I thought, it was also quite cold in the room, and one day there was no water and electricity, but communication with the owner was pleasant

A great little cozy place in the heart of taksîm square.
It’s easy to get to from the bus stops or tram station. It’s like a 10 min walk from the isteklal street or town centre.
The host (mehmet) is a great guy, very helpful.
You can check in at anytime he is available around the clock.
The street has a lot of restaurants and stores for grocer items.
The apartment is small but enough for 2 people and has all the amenities for a few days.
Rooms are tidy and clean, location is very convenient, walking distance to Istiklal and Taksim Midan. If you’re two make sure to ask about the bigger room.

description:
Charming vintage-style apartment with 2 queen beds, full kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, AC, washer/dryer. Located on a quiet, safe street in the heart of Galata—just steps from Galata Tower, Karaköy ferries, tram to Old City, and Istiklal Street. Surrounded by cafes, boutiques & restaurants. Perfect for families & groups!
Safe neighbourhood
Every major attraction istanbul has to affer is walkable

reviews.text:
The apartment was absolutely beautiful. The description and photos match the reality, everything was spot-on clean, and was worth the money we paid. The internet connection was fast and stable. The area is fantastic. It is very central, and the apartment is just a short walk to the tram stop and to the metro station. There are several nice coffee shops, small or fancy restaurants on the same street or in walking distance. We also found it a lot better, more convenient, interesting, and relaxed to be staying here rather than on the other side of the city.
The only unfortunate thing could be that the building is nice but quite old, meaning the soundproof is not like we are used to today. But not a critical point at all.
Communication with Elif was great. The response time was always just a few minutes, and my every question or concern was addressed. The check-in process was clear and easy, as well as check-out. Thank you, Elif! Staying at your place made our vacation truly wonderful.

PRO- Great location, Galata tower right across the corner
- located in a quite street with a cafe downstairs
- Ample space in master bedroom and lounge
- Aesthetically decorated
- Ample sunshine in the lounge if you want to just relax in the morning
-great restaurants, cafes, salons and art studios in the neighbourhood
CONS-Washroom basin incredibly tiny, We had trouble washing our faces, one is bound to get wet and pour water everywhere if using the washbasin
- Toilet seat cover was broken
- The hot water geezer runs out of hot water if one or two people take shower, so if you have a family or more than two individuals, you need to wait for more water to heat up
- The apartment building is located on a height hence not recommended for the elderly or families with young children
- washroom had a strong muggy smell
- kitchen does not have a microwave as described in the post

Firstly Elif was a great host - he waited for us to reach close to midnight as I had requested for help with luggage on the stairs to the apartment. There is no elevator but the stairs are not steep. The apartment was clean and around 7 mins away from the Galata Tower, has good restaurants around, 10 mins away from the tram station, 12 mins away from Istiklal street, so everything’s walkable and close. The living room and big bedroom have an ac, but the small bedroom doesn’t, however the apartment comes with a strong fan that can be kept in this room. The kitchen is well equipped. The bathroom was a bit small for our liking and the door didn’t have a lock. We stayed for 4 nights and were very comfortable.

Elif's place is very chic and matches the pictures provided. Check in was easy and well explained. The sheets and bathroom were spotlessly clean, and the master bedroom is generously sized. The water was hot, and shower pressure strong. While I really loved the look of the wooden floorboards, we found them to be quite noisy to walk on - my one year old quickly worked this out and began thumping around whenever she moved about the apartment - so, if like us you have young children this is something to keep in mind. I did find myself worrying that we were making too much noise for the neighbours!
Although the apartment is in a very busy area, we found the street to be quiet and easy for our little ones to get to sleep at night. If you have little ones, I would recommend using a baby carrier in the area rather than a pram, as the streets in the surrounding area aren't very pram friendly!
Elif is very responsive and helpful. I would recommend his place.

We had a fantastic stay at this apartment. Check in was straightforward with the host giving clear guidance ahead of our arrival. The apartment was as described and like the photos. It was very clean, comfortable and had all amenities that we needed. The location was excellent for us. It was close to great restaurants, shops and the Galata tower but was in a very quiet street. We walked everywhere, around 40 minutes to Hagia Sophia but there is good public transport too if preferred. Highly recommended!

description: Experience Istanbul from our elegant Ottoman Design Apartment in the historic peninsula. This private, fully furnished space comfortably fits five guests. Featuring ornate details and modern comforts, you're just a 10-minute walk from the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Grand Bazaar. Perfect for a memorable cultural getaway.

reviews.text: We had a great stay at this two-bedroom apartment for 22 days as a family of four. The host was excellent—very friendly, helpful, and always responded quickly whenever we had any questions. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well looked after. We really appreciated the weekly cleaning service, with fresh bedding and towels changed once a week. The location is fantastic, with plenty of local restaurants, cafés, supermarkets, and shops nearby. It’s also close to the train station, making it easy to explore the city’s main attractions. A couple of small improvements would make the stay even better: adding a microwave would be useful, and replacing the iron, as it was leaking water during use. Also, the apartment is on the third floor with no lift, so it may not be suitable for elderly guests or anyone with mobility or leg issues. Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would happily recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a clean, well-located place with a great host.

You can put your trust in Ahmet and his apartment! Just like in the photos, the flat is spacious for a 4 member family and well equipped with kitchen utensils so that you can cook straightaway. The location is perfect. You can go on foot and visit the key sightseeing spots. Ahmet and his female colleague’s hospitality manifested in many ways. First, you can find slippers to wear and complimentary/welcome water, tea and coffee (very thoughtful of the host!). Second, the co-host was very helpful and gave us insightful tips about Istanbul. Third, I recommend everyone to book the airport transfer via Ahmet. It was a very comfortable, carefree and reliable ride. Morever, it was the cheapest airport transfer price that we knew.

Apartment looked like in photos, Ahmet and his employee at the reception were very friendly and helpful. He let us keep the luggage at the reception because we had an early arrival and late departure. There were issues that for some might be deal breakers (the bathroom had little issues like the toilet didn't flush fully and the water from the shower got on the whole floor) but for us it was ok. Lots of restaurants in the area and is walkable to important visiting places. Pretty close to public transport. Lots of shops in the area with lower prices than rest of the city, also accidently found a mini-bazar. Good conditions for the money, I recommend his apartments.

Our two-week stay at Mevlud and Yuliia's place in Istanbul was absolutely perfect, and they are truly a wonderful host. From the moment we arrived, they made us feel welcome and went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed.
The apartment itself was exactly what we were looking for. It was clean, very comfortable, and provided a fantastic base for exploring the city. The location was good, allowing us to easily get around and feel like we were living like locals.
Yuliia was also helpful with her local recommendations, from the best places to eat to tips on public transportation. Her communication was always prompt and friendly, and she was always available to answer any questions we had.

I had a wonderful stay at Ahmet’s place in Istanbul. He was extremely responsive and genuinely kind, you really don’t meet hosts like him everywhere. When my plans unexpectedly changed and I asked for a refund, he accepted immediately without any hassle, which I truly appreciated.
The apartment itself was beyond my imagination: very clean, tidy, and thoughtfully arranged. Ahmet clearly has great taste, from the furniture to the dishes, everything felt well chosen and cozy. I also loved the tea maker/water boiler; it was a very interesting design that kept the water hot at the press of a button , something I had never seen before.
There was a very slight odor in the room, but honestly, it’s not even worth mentioning compared to how great the overall experience was (so I’ll just laugh that part off 😄).
All in all, an excellent stay with an amazing host. Highly recommended.

description: You'll have a good accommodation experience in the most special district of Istanbul. If you care about intercultural communication, architecture and art, you'll feel like you are in the movie "L'immortelle (1963)".

reviews.text:
I stayed summer 2026, it was overrated. noisy , major construction next to the building starting at 7am and going on all day, building is surrendered by dangerous stray dogs which attacked us several times and it was stressful and we got injured, after your booking get confirmed unit comes with rules and instructions like you don’t have hot water unless you turn it on 3 hours before,
Location is near to attractions not far but still needs taxi for everywhere.
And host was rude to me at the end for no reason, like asking me to clean the bed sheets for next guest before check out, And talking rude to me, it was an uncomfortable and isolating experience.

The place looks as described and the host is very friendly and responsive . There were initial misunderstandings in the stay - the owner never mentioned she has 2 dogs in the apartment and there was a shared bathroom - although I booked the entire place - but we sorted that out quickly and it became a peasant stay. The apartment’s view is its best feature - Taksim metro station and Kabatas for the ferry are walking distance and few restaurants but you can find more 15 min walk in Cihangir. The apartment is large and has all what you need, it is a good option if you don’t have mobility problems as there is not elevator and the area is hilly.

This was my second stay at Basra's gorgeous home. It is the best AirBnb experience ever. The location is spectacular, only minutes from the ferry at Kabatas, the funicular to Taksim Square, and the tram to the old city. Super quiet at night and sanctuary from a lot of tourists. Seriously, with a IstanbulKart, you can get anywhere so easily. Busra is a dream host, so kind and caring. Her home has stunning views of Asia and the Bosporus, feels like home, very comfortable bed, and a fully stocked kitchen. I could not be happier and will be back. Just minutes to Galataport, Besiktas, Dolmabahce palace, and easy trip by funicular and sky tram to Nisantasi. Very cool spots like Kaiser's Kabatas and Setup just a few minutes walk. Small gourmet grocery store (MacroCenter/Migros) very close. I have stayed at nearly 100 AIrBnbs, and this is easily the best. Amazing. Thanks you Busra; I will be back.

I stayed at this apartment in Kabataş and it was one of the best experiences I’ve had in Istanbul. The place is incredibly stylish and cozy — you can feel the designer’s touch in every detail, from the furniture to the lighting. Everything is well thought out, making the stay both comfortable and enjoyable.
The location is another big plus: just a few minutes’ walk to Kabataş and the waterfront, with easy access to Beşiktaş, Taksim, and Galata. The neighborhood is quiet and safe, with plenty of cafés, shops, and public transport nearby 😍

Incredible location in the heart of Istanbul, with a wonderful view of the Bosphorus. The apartment is gorgeous, well decorated, and extremely comfortable with all the amenities you might need. it's a 10-minute walk to public transport so very easy to get around the city, although it's uphill back from the apartment, so if you have mobility issues it could be more difficult. The host Buşra was so helpful and great to communicate with. We will be back!
