reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at this stunning 3-bedroom apartment! From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by how clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated the space was. Each bedroom was comfortable and well-appointed, with cozy beds, soft linens, and plenty of storage. The living area was perfect for our group, offering a great place to relax and unwind after a day of exploring.
The kitchen had everything we needed to prepare meals, and the dining area was spacious for our meals together. The apartment also had modern amenities, including fast Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and plenty of thoughtful touches that made us feel right at home.
The location was ideal—close to everything we wanted to see and do, but tucked away in a quiet neighborhood for peace and privacy. Our host was incredibly responsive and welcoming, providing us with helpful recommendations for local attractions and dining.
Overall, this apartment exceeded our expectations and provided the perfect home base.

We (family of four) had a wonderful stay in this beautiful and spacious apartment. Arif was a very kind and responsive host, prompt and helpful in his communications.
The apartment itself is modern and light filled with everything you need for a great stay including comfortable beds, wifi, a full kitchen with dishwasher, laundry and more. It is in a lovely calm location, close to shops, restaurants and easy walking distance to various public transport including the M4 metro line or Marmary (train).
We found it ideal to see the main tourist sites while getting a feel for local life. We also appreciated the friendly vibes of the neighbourhood. Overall, we loved our time discovering Istanbul from this accommodation and hope to come back one day.

We stayed at the Arefs flat for nearly a month and had an outstanding experience. The flat features three spacious bedrooms with double beds and an extra sofa bed, plus a full kitchen perfect for breakfast. The fast WiFi and smart TV added to our comfort. The science museum next door was a huge hit with our kids, offering a variety of activities, including a coffee shop, ice cream shop, and restaurant. The location was excellent, with a 20-30 minute walk to the city center&Moda Port, Akasya Mall & Tepe AVM and local bazaar ( Tuesday and Friday) We rarely needed a taxi, and the nearby bus station made trips easy when needed. Highly recommended! 10/10 amazing communication with Mr Aref. family and I already thinking about coming back.

“Arif’s flat was absolutely fantastic! The space was incredibly clean, well-maintained, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The three bedrooms were spacious and perfect for our group. The location was ideal—convenient, yet in a cool area with lots to explore nearby. Arif was a great host, responsive and helpful. I highly recommend staying here and would definitely return!” ❤️

Safe area and very easy to get around. Found the host very helpful when I had questions. The area was nice as everything was walking distance such as the metro and grocery stores. The rooms were clean and the apartment felt nice to walk around in. The elevator was very helpful to get stuff to and from the rooms if you were to rent more than 1 room. Overall had a very good experience and would recommend to someone who is looking for a place to stay for a short visit to Turkey.

description:
Wireless internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text:
I had a very nice stay. Great residance with a lot of facilities which are great for relaxing after a long day of exploring the beautiful city of Istanbul. Also safety is guaranteed with 24/7 security, they are lovely people which are always in the mood for a quick chat and helpfull when needed. Had zero issues during my stay. Beds and bathrooms were clean and the whole residance was just splendid. Would really recommend staying here. Only little downside is that there is no public transportation very near, it's a 15 minute walk to Taksim metro station. But there are always taxi's closeby.
Would come here again if i'm coming back to Istanbul!

We had very pleasant stay in the apartment. It was very clean and comfy just as shown in the pictures. The apartments are well located.
Eerything with check-in and check-out went very smooth, all my questions were answered very quickly.
I would definitely recommend this place.

We enjoyed our stay at Benesta, which was over a week. Istanbul is a hilly city (similar to San Francisco), it takes less than 10 minutes to walk from Taksim sq. to our apartment but it’d take much longer to walk back, so better to get a taxi. The unit was clean, cozy, with a nice view, and equipped with all the necessary appliances. Our host (Duygu) helped us during the check-in and was very responsive whenever we had any questions or requests. Looking forward to our next visit to Istanbul and another stay at Benesta!

Our stay in this apartment was perfectly comfortable. Aprtment is clean and very well equipped. The building is modern and safe, we also used underground parking, so that was very convenient for us. I would definitely recommend to stay here!

The place was very clean and secured. The co Host was friendly.
Just to mentioned one thing, the building is located beside a school, with a bit of nois around the area from 7AM onward.
Overall, the place is good and recommended.

description: A cozy comfortable room in the center of Taksim, close to everywhere. You will feel very special in the 140-year-old historical building.

reviews.text:
Pros: Location close to restaurants and sights (walkable), secure door, shower pressure and temp, as described amenities, washing service on request provided by Faith as well as great responsive communication.
Cons: stayed for four nights and the room/toilet bin were not cleaned (after being told it would be on day 3), the foyer just outside our room door was a little noisy, people upstairs could be heard all night talking/moving/walking/everything... the noise transfer between rooms was significant.

Stay was good, room was a bit smaller than we thought but did the job. The room is hot and there is no air conditioning, so we kept the windows open, however the windows opened over the smoking courtyard so we smelled smoke 24/7.
There was also a power outage for hours overnight and 1 of the guests couldn’t get in the front door with an electronic pin, so they just banged on the door for 20 straight minutes at 2 in the morning. We woke up thinking someone was breaking in, it was quite terrifying. The host responded to our concerned messages shortly after but the banging did go on for 20 minutes before he answered and got in touch with this guest. Location was ok, we took Uber into town.

Fatih was a great host - very friendly and he was able to help us extend our reservation. The location is close to istikal street and a cool artsy antique neighborhood with lots of cafes and restaurants. It is a bit of a walk to the metro, but depending on where you are going, there is a bus stop just a few minutes walk away from the bnb. The room is small, but comfortable. If you have a lot of luggage, I would recommend booking one of his larger rooms in the complex. You can also hear noise from outdoors or from above (it is a historic building); so if you are sensitive to noise, I would recommend ear plugs. All in all I think this spot is a great deal for the price

We were in awe of the historical value of the property and little details of Turkish art included in the room. Despite being a very old building, the toilet and room was modern and exceptionally clean. We also appreciated that the bed was spacious and comfortable. Location-wise: this room is only a walking distance (5 minutes) to Istilklal Street for those who want to shop till you drop. Fatih as the host was very friendly and welcoming; he suggested the best local delicatessen in Istanbul. Would definitely rebook this airbnb in the future.

The location was perfect, just tucked away from the hustle and bustle but right there when you need it. The hosts were pleasant and very helpful.
We were on the ground floor which had little to-no sound proofing but didn’t mind as the evenings were pretty and as is expected with such a historic building. Bathroom was tidy, great shower, comfy bed. BYO toiletries if you’re picky.
Would highly recommend for the value!

description: This is a room in my little historical building, which I renovated it in late 2011. I rent my flats usually to young travelers, students or also some professionals who wants to get some experience in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
pros: The room is cute and comfortable & looks exactly as pictured except the wall mirror isn’t there. There’s a smaller mirror on the desk now so it’s fine. Baran was kind and greeted me very nicely. Showed me around the home, etc. The bathroom is nicer than the photos. There’s glass doors instead of a shower curtain. The neighborhood is very close to Taksim square ( shops and restaurants& train) and very convenient for walking! The local weekly Bazaar is literally right outside the front door on Sundays! (Try not to move in or out on Sunday because cars can’t drive by). There’s a grocery store really close by and the clerk is very nice.
Cons: Baran was unresponsive after the first couple of days ( but I think he works nights so I understand). He took all of the toilet paper out of the bathroom without warning. Maybe I used too much? Not a surprise I liked. His mom comes by the apartment and cooks for him frequently (with very loud banging) and doesn’t say hi when you speak to her (but maybe she’s shy). The neighborhood is a bit sketchy. Abandoned buildings etc. The windows are in the back of the home and they all face other people’s windows (they are very close so they can see everything). There’s a lot of smoke here. I coughed for like a week straight. I don’t know what the smell is. Wood burning fire places maybe? Cigarettes? I’m not sure. Smelled bad. The bed wasn’t comfy. I went to Ikea to buy my own pillow.
Overall: I was supposed to stay here for a month while looking for a long term place but I had to leave before two weeks had passed because I was choking from the smoke. I texted Baran (cohost who lives inside the apartment) to tell him I found my permanent place (I was very nice and said thank you etc) and ask how to check out & where to leave the keys & etc and never received a response. Even still I have never heard back to say goodbye or anything at all.
It’s cute and cheap. You get what you pay for.

Clean, comfortable space in an apartment with solid kitchen basics, nice natural light, and good access to different transit options (10 min. walk to Istiklal, 15 min. walk to Taksim square with 3 lira neighborhood vans and the metro). The neighborhood's weekly market, the Tarlabaşı Pazarı, is literally right outside your door every Sunday which is pretty awesome. Baran is a great host, and you can expect to make friends (human and cat) throughout the neighborhood. Prepare to hunt mosquitos before bed every night!

What impressed me most and was greatly appreciated is that though Pinar is in Kenya, she's a fantastic troubleshooter. She was fast and efficient tackling a couple of problems that came up. Her friend Zeki who welcomed me is also very kind and accommodating.
The description of the room is accurate. It's functionable and pretty spacious for a "long short stay". I'd agree with other visitors that an A/C unit is necessary to cope with summer heat. Also I could do with some more crockery and cutlery in the kitchen. I'd also recommend a shower cabin to prevent the water flooding the whole bathroom. It needed moping right after every shower. The laundry room in the building is fully equipped, but the last few days of my stay there was no power in it. It'd be good if there's a weekly check in the building.
The area is exactly like Pinar describes it. Yes, it's run-down, noisy, a bit dirty but it has an authentic flair of its own. The people seem a bit scary at the beginning, but once you approach them, they open up and treat you with utmost friendliness. It'd be good to speak some Turkish, as this helps a lot in your daily interactions.
Taxim and bus stops / subway stations are a 10-minute "climb" and it takes courage to walk up the hill. But then, all amenities and the beauty of Istanbul are wide open to you.
I'd definitely stay again in this room, and, yes, in Tarlabasi too!

I've been living in Pinar's place for almost two months now and I really enjoy this place. The building is located just 5-10 minutes walk from Istiklal but in a local area that gives a different charming experience of Istanbul than the fancy touristic areas. There's a supermarked just around the corner and a lively marked every Sunday whith vegetables, cheeses, clothes and more.

The atmosphere in the building (which has washing machines, drying racks, vacuum cleaners) is good and you don't get a feeling that a lot of people come and go all the time. It's nice and calm here and everybody takes care of the place.

In the neighboring apartment next to my room there is a carpenter's workshop, and he makes quite a bit of noise sometimes during the day, but if you're out and about in Istanbul during the day that's of course not a problem. If I come home in the night I'll take a taxi but up untill around midnight there's usually quite a lot of people out in the streets and walking home is fine.

Pinar has been super helpfull with everything from small practical things in the apartment to lending me an extra matress and things like that. She also has a couple of really nice friends who turn up in no time if needed (since Pinar is living in Africa at the time I'm staying here).

Pinar's Airbnb at 83 Kurdela sok, matches the description you get. It is bright, clean and basic. Comfortable but not luxurious. But fair value for the price. Pinar provides good directions online and there is someone to meet you when you arrive even if she can't be there.
While the Dolapdere area is a little rundown, there is a brilliant street market every Sunday. You are conveniently placed for the main roads into the centre (after a steep uphill walk) into Taksim and into the Old City.
Although you have your own bedroom, the flat and facilities are shared so you are taking a bit of chance with your flatmate but mine was fine.

description:
Jun-Do Taksim is located in the heart of Istanbul. Just few steps away to Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue.
The building has 7 airbnb apartments with large elevator. Each apartment has new furniture with well equipped. We try to think everything for our guest comfort.
High class, comfy,, luxury,,,whatever you need by eRa Quality.

reviews.text:
If you're looking for a very responsive, communicative, and flexible host, this is the place for you. Iso was incredibly kind, accommodating both our check-in and check-out times. He provided everything we requested within minutes. The location is just a few minutes' walk from Istiklal Street, making it very accessible. The place is exactly as described. However, if you plan to cook or store items in the fridge, be aware that the kitchenette, oven, and fridge are quite small. Aside from that, everything was fine. The bathroom is also very small, but given the typical size of homes in Istanbul, I believe Iso did his best to make the space functional. The patio isn't ideal for hanging out unless you plan to smoke shisha.There's a grocery store and several bakeries nearby. The elevator worked consistently, which is rare in this city.
The only downside was the noise. There's a constant buzz of honking, partying, and music, but this doesn't reflect on Iso as a host or the quality of place.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5)
We stayed at Jundo’s place and overall had a very good experience. The host was amazing — communication was perfect, and he helped us with everything we needed throughout our stay. The group was also very attentive and quickly solved the air conditioning problem as soon as we mentioned it.
The location is very accessible, which made getting around easy, though it can be a bit loud at times. The price is quite reasonable for what you get.
The main area for improvement is the shower room, which really needs renovation and was not up to a clean standard. Apart from that, everything else was well managed thanks to the host’s efforts.

I had a wonderful stay at this place in Istanbul. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent, with easy access to public transportation, restaurants, and attractions.
The host was extremely kind, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay, making sure we had everything we needed. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and hassle-free.
Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. I would happily stay here again

Great stay – highly recommend!
The apartment was clean, cozy, and exactly like the photos. Great location, close to everything . The host was super friendly and helpful, and check-in was easy.
It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay – would definitely come back!

Everything was very good specially the communication with the owners but unfortunately the noise from outside was the only hindrance to giving this place a 5 stars.
A switch to sound proofing double glazing windows will definitely give this place the 5 stars it deserves.
The place is sparkling clean modern and new, exactly as shown on the pictures in the add. Location excellent for people who like the Taksim Area.
As last advice get your earplugs and book this luxury apartment right the way!

description: Cozy flat

reviews.text:
I stayed a week with my son.
The host answered very quickly.
My son loved the swimming pool and the gym.
It was nice to have a large market, shops, and restaurants nearby.
I delivered water, food, Starbucks, etc. and it is a convenient place
The room was clean and everything (kitchen, pot, pen, big refrigerator) was well.
It is a safe area, so I will visit again next time.

Clean place , grocery stores nearby
Near to city Center
Very supportive staff
The flat is too small, the way smaller than a hotel room. I’d recommend only for short stays.
Very straight forward check in. Host was very responsive for check in/out and during the stay. If you want to stay in a relatively quite neighbourhood it's a good choice.

I liked the location where the apartments are located. Near a shop, restaurants, fast food outlets. The bus stop is 5-10 minutes away.
The apartment is cozy, the entrance is well guarded.

description: We have specially designed this apartment for couples and families who prefer a peaceful stay in a very central location. The apartment consists of 2 bedrooms and a living room. Baby cot is provided in case you need it. There is an elevator in the building and 24/7 security at the entrance. There is a large shared courtyard with wonderful landscape design, where you can enjoy a cup of coffee after a tiring day. We can guarantee it is impossible to find any courtyard like this.

reviews.text: I have no hesitation in recommending Dilek's place (except, perhaps, the price). Dilek's apartment is part of a new residential complex which is very rare in this part of Istanbul. The location is really good and, importantly, there is an elevator in the building (you still have to climb ~12 steps or walk uphill for ~50 meters if you use the side entrance). The unit is quiet and is exactly as seen in the photos, unlike many AirBnB listings in Istanbul. The complex features a 24/7 janitor and a sloped garden space which is quite small but nice. In terms of cleanness and communication, the score is 10 out of 10. I would recommend that you try to book this place closer to your travel date to get a better deal; otherwise, be prepared to pay a premium.

Dileks place is exactly as described. Nice and clean, and suitable for 4 people, and centrally located for site seeing. The space is very close to Galata towers which is a great first stop to get your bearings. There are also lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance.
Dilek was great with communication, and was able to accommodate an early check-in which was highly needed after a long overnight flight.
Overall a great experience for our party of 4. Would stay here again.
Tips:
1. Start your trip with Galata tower viewing
2. Try at least one of the restaurants in front of the house
3. Spend some time in the garden. It’s lovely!
4. Go to Mums Cafe for brunch! It’s about 8 minutes walking from the place, and has amazing food!
5. Go to Cukurcuma Hamam. It’s a hidden gem about 13 minutes walk from the Airbnb, and best value for money!

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything I needed was available, and the apartment felt cozy and welcoming from the first moment.
The location was excellent — easy to get around, close to local attractions, cafes, and public transportation, which made exploring the city very convenient.
The host was extremely kind, responsive, and helpful, always ready to assist with any questions and provide great local tips. Communication was smooth and easy throughout the stay.
I truly enjoyed my time here and felt at home. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would happily stay here again!

Dilek’s place was exactly what we were expecting, and was very nice. We would highly recommend the flat for a couple or small family.
Location: The flat is in a fun location - not too far from touristy things and not far from fun neighborhoods. The neighborhood was nice, felt safe and was quiet. We were even able to watch lots of stray cats each morning from the kitchen table
Flat: The whole flat looked exactly like the pictures, it was clean and well stocked. The second room was perfect to put the crib in for our toddler and the high chair made meals easier. The building was also quiet and had a security guard on staff 24/7.
Dilek as a host: Dilek is very Kind and was well prepared with all the appliance information and was very quick to answer any questions we had about the flat or the city.

We had a fantastic stay at Dilek’s beautiful apartment! The location is unbeatable—just a short walk to the iconic Galata Tower, yet very quiet, private, and safe. I was a bit nervous when I saw a negative review prior to our arrival. Unlike what was described in that review, the apartment was clean, neat, and comfortable.
Our host was incredibly friendly and kind. She allowed us to check in early, which made our arrival so much smoother. Plus, the proximity to public transport and the ferry terminal made getting around Istanbul a breeze. Highly recommend!

description:
Lovely private room in shared apartment, 5 mins walk to Beşyol metrobüs station, safe and quiet area with all markets around.

Long terms allowed. Suitable for Erasmus students.

reviews.text:
mohamed was very friendly calm and peaceful helpfull and very organised person , the check in went smooth knowing that It was late ar night .
the apartment unfortunately doesn't match the pictures or maybe the pictures were taken using wide camera , the apartment is quite small , and walls are thin . hot on summer day but mohamed offered me a fan.
the kitchen is fine with all what you need to do minimal cooking .
the location is amazing 5min walk to metrobus besyol , if you are close to the metro bus you are close to everything 24h/24h also the apartment is very close to bim and 101 .
I recommend staying at mohamed s! you get more than what you pay for.

Mohamed is a friendly, kind, and very helpful person. The flat is clean and furnished with everything a visitor might possibly need to feel at ease and at home. Being on the first floor, it is conveniently accessible, well-located, and in a safe neighbourhood. There are many shops, cafes and restaurants close by, as well as a well-stocked supper market directly across from the apartment. When I return to Istanbul, I'm excited to stay at Mohamed's flat, and I heartily recommend it to anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable place to stay. Many thanks, Mohamed.

I stayed at Mohamed's place during the Istanbul Dance Festival.
The place was clean and the room matched the photos. There was a bit of miscommunication due to my time frame and tight schedule.
I met Mohamed when I arrived, he told me to text him whenever I needed and I guess he left the place.
There were a few things that I wish I could change: there was no plug in the bathroom or a mirror in the room, which made it difficult to dry my hair. And at night the room got really cold. Also I didn't know the number to order the water.
I think it would be a more pleasant stay for someone with more free time.

I had a fantastic stay at Mohamed's listing! The location was perfect for me as a student at Istanbul Aydin University, just a quick 10-minute walk away. The neighborhood was vibrant with markets and close to transportation, making everything convenient. The apartment itself was cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities I needed. Mohamed was a wonderful host, responsive and accommodating. I highly recommend this listing to anyone visiting Istanbul!"

Felt comfortable and welcomed. He helped me out when I was arriving very late and was a nice person to talk with. Ordered food for me while I was a bit confused how it works and had the best pomegranate to share. Nice guy and good place to start my adventure in Istanbul. Metrostation near by. Very important
Thanks and good luck

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
It was one of the best experiences I had in AirBnB.
Place totally reflects the things listed on the add and on the previous comments. The host was very quick in reply, helpful and tried her best to serve the best experience ever.
House was clean, kitchen appliances were full and it was just like on the photos.
Building has 24h security which makes you feel safe.
Host was very helpful and flexible with check in and check out times.
It was a 5 star experience in general!

Amazing location! Very beautiful paths that you can walk. restaurants, coffee shops , groceries are accessible only few feets from the building. The apartment was very spacious, clean and well equiped. It is exactly as shown in the pictures.
host is really kind and responsive I highly recommend it for long stays, for both family and couples vacations.

Aysun was a polite and accommodating host. Always responsive. It seems she is new to Airbnb and she’s off to a great start.
I felt safe and at-home in the apartment. When traveling to a foreign country, in an h known neighborhood, one never knows what to expect. Fortunately, I felt safe in Aysun’s apartment.
There only one difficult point. It is far from Istanbul city center. You will have to take the metro or long taxi rides. It stifled my plans to see more nightlife in Istanbul. The area around Jae apartment has no nightlife and don’t expect alcohol in any of the restaurants. It is a conservative area. However, that also allows a visitor to experience how local people live. Overall, Aysun’s place was really comfortable and recommendable. Aysun was a great host.
this is a great place to stay, nice neighborhood, great balcony with a beautiful view, nice light, strong internet. Aysun is a kind and helpful host. I would definitely stay here again

Küçük ama temiz ve ferah bir ev, klima da olsa şahane olurdu. güçlü bir fan ile serinliyorsunuz
konum çekmeköy metroya 5 km civarında, etrafında çocuklarınız için 600 mt ve 1.5 km uzakta küçük ve uzakta olan -büyük park alanı mevcut, büyük olan ormanlık bir yürüyüş alanı da barındırıyor. Marketler yakın. Metro inşaatı olduğu için ulaşım kolay olsa bile şile kuzey marmara bğlantısı için 30 dk daha erken çıkmanızı öneririm.

description: You can relax as a family in this peaceful accommodation. A large and spacious apartment on a high floor in a safe residence, there is a swimming pool and gym in the site, the apartment's furniture is brand new, new, modern and luxurious brands, I am sure that the people who come will like it, it has a fast Wi-Fi system, it is easy to access the metro and metrobus, shopping center, weekly market, university, hospital, airport, European side.

reviews.text: Saeid is a very good and nice host. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures and very clean. The location of the apartment is very suitable if you like it a little quieter but has supermarkets, restaurants, hairdressers, etc. right outside the door. I would book the accommodation again at any time.

From the moment we booked, to the moment we arrived and beyond, Saeid was very responsive and provided great information. He met us at the location and helped us with all the luggage (we had too many as we were moving to Istanbul) . The unit was super clean, very well decorated and very conveniently located near great public transportation (metro, metrobus, bus all between 7-15 minute walk) as well as plenty of rental scooters around. Plus, grabbing a taxi was rarely an issue. There are 2 lux coffee shops in the buildings across the street and a couple of great little restaurant for grabbing a simit in the morning or burgers/pizza. Overall, we really enjoyed our stay.

Recommended!
If you're looking for a good place, please read.
Saied was super friendly and relaxed - he charged and gave me his Istanbul card, which I forgot to return when I left Istanbul (I still have it). I also managed to break some of the dinnerware. The response to both was - "don't worry, it's no problem". 10/10 service.
The place - everything is as advertised. The location is super comfortable and peaceful. The locals were friendly.
Supermarkets, kiosks, pharmacies, everything you need is right by your door. There is also Ganni Lounge - a very trendy place with good and reasonably priced food and hookah right there.
You are just a couple of stops away from famous and beautiful Kadikoy. Or about 7 minutes with Taxi to Moda. Depending on traffic, you can reach IST airport in about 40 minutes, and SAB in about 30 minutes.
I stayed for 2 weeks with my girlfriend on a spontaneous work-from-home trip. It was perfect, after work we would relax in the pool.

Ev çok düzenli ve temizdi. Konum olarak metrobüse çok yakın ve etrafta bir çok lokanta ve kafe var.
Kendimi çok güvende hissettim. Herhangi bir sorunda ev sahibi anında yardımcı oldu. Özellikle Mehdi bey çok yardımcı ve ilgiliydi.
Saied ve Mehdi beye bu güzel konaklama için teşekkür ediyorum.

Evin konumu mükemmeldi, bütün marketlere ve kafelere çok yakındı. Ayrıca Akasya AVM’ye çok çok yakındı. Ulaşım da çok güzel, metrobüs hemen yakında ve taksi bulmak hiç zor olmadı. Ev kesinlikle fotoğraflardaki gibi çok güzel. Rezidans güvende hissettirdi ve manzarası da çok güzeldi. Herkese tavsiye ederim, çok güzel bir konaklama yaşadık :)

description:
In the heart of Beşiktaş, you will feel as peaceful as at home in this private apartment with 2 bedrooms, 1 balcony, equipped with trees and ethnic breezes. We offer you a living space that is free from the noise of the city, even though it is in the center.

The location of our house is a few blocks away, please message us for the actual location

reviews.text: The location of the place is very nice, there are a lot of nice restaurants and shops nearby, it’s also close to attractions and not in a noisy area. During the whole stay, the communication with Kaan was just great and responsive. However, the place itself wasn’t as nice as we expected, the bedsheets were dirty and smelly. We were lucky to find other ones in the wardrobe that appeared to be cleaner. There was a lot of hair on the floor and ants in the bathroom. There were no kitchen amenities for cooking, but the kitchen was too tiny and dark that it was not appealing to use. Also in the pictures, there is a balcony, but during our stay, the balcony wasn’t usable, it was full of some stuff and drying bedsheets that were simply thrown onto the balcony and not neatly arranged.

Evde biraz karınca vardı. Salondaki Vantilatöre dikkat edin, küçük bir bakıma ihtiyacı olabilir ☺️. Buzdolabı soğutmuyor. O da aynı şekilde bakıma ihtiyacı var. Arka odada perde kısa kalıyor. Temizlik ve konum açısından gayet güzel. Fotoğraftaki bitkiler yoktu ve ev biraz yıpranmış gibiydi. Aradaki odanın sürgülü kapısı sıkışabiliyor. Açıp kapatması zor. Ama fiyat performans ve temizlik açısından beğendik. Ev 7 kişilik gösteriyor; 2 çift kişilik yataklı oda var ve salonda 2 kişilik L bir koltuk var. Max 6 kişi sığar gibimize geldi. Gelmeden ev sahibine sormanızı öneririm ☺️

The location of the accommodation is beautifully central, making it easy to walk everywhere. However, the house requires significant maintenance. The bathroom was in poor condition, with a showerhead that wouldn't stay up and no water pressure, we had to travel to friend’s house to have showers. The apartment also had a strong cigarette smell. With no flyscreens on the windows, flies were constantly getting in, and I even had a spider fall on me in bed and in the bathroom. Due to the humidity and stuffiness inside, the windows couldn't be kept closed without sacrificing airflow so we had no choice but to deal with flies. The beds were uncomfortable, and on a cold night, there were only thin top sheets with no duvets available.
While the living room is as beautiful as shown in the pictures and the location is perfect, it’s not an ideal place to stay if you’re after comfort and cleanliness.

The flat is in a great location for exploring Beşiktaş and check-in was very smooth.
Unfortunately, the property doesn't match the photos in the listing. The plants, coffee table, and balcony furniture shown here did not exist. Instead, the balcony was being used to hang laundry. Several lights weren't working, including in the living room and bathroom, though enough were working for this not to be too big of an issue. The kitchen lacked basic amenities. As others have mentioned, the showerhead was broken and additionally when we arrived there was no hot water. Thankfully Kaan responded quickly to our messages and explained that the hot water had been turned off at the boiler for maintenance, giving us instructions on how to turn it back on, but we had a deadline that morning and this advice came after a very cold shower.
Overall, the place felt quite run-down and not really as advertised.

Not what was displayed and advertised in the photos at all. When we checked into Kaans place it was very late and we were exhausted. He allowed us to leave our luggage before check in time in the apartment, leave and allow the maid to clean until 4 PM when we were able to check in. I appreciate that he allowed us to do that, however, when we were back, the place still smelt like heavy cigarette smoke and alcohol. The floors were very dirty and had stains and hair on them, the sheets were not clean and therefore we had to ask the maid to re-change the sheets and put new ones, unfortunately the towels were being washed and put out in the balcony to dry. The bathroom had no toiletries, it only had one bottle of soap. Shower head is broken. We ended our stay one day short out of the two days booked. This place is nothing like the pictures, nor the description that he has posted, it needs MAJOR cleaning and renovation done.

description: We offer a unique experience to our guests with the closest hotel to Istanbul Airport and the closest hotel to the new airport.

reviews.text: We had a really good experience staying here. The place was clean, comfortable and welcoming, and the host was friendly and responsive. The location was especially convenient, being only about 15 minutes from the airport, which made it perfect for our trip. We really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend it.
Cheap and cheerful, the hotel is easy for a short overnight stay waiting for a flight. Tidy accommodation
It was a good stay, the room and the bathroom was clean. It 100% worth the price. I would recommend it.
very clean and nice hotel.
price is ok but a very bad experience, communication wasn't the best!

reviews.text: Ev sahibi çok ilgili ve kibardı ev fotoğraflarda olduğundan daha ferah son derece temiz ve düzenliydi konum olarak güzel ve merkezi gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilirsiniz çok memnun kaldım her konuda yardımcı oldukları için çok teşekkür ediyorum
Konum merkezi ulaşım kolaydı rahat ve temizdi . Daire Fotoğrafta göründüğü gibiydi. Burak bey ilgili bir ev sahibiydi.

Değerlendirmemi, başta yaşadığımız karşılıklı anlaşmazlıktan bağımsız yapacağım.
Yorumlara bakarak ailem için bu evi 2 günlüğüne tuttum ama doğruyu söylemek gerekirse pişman oldum ve zaten 2. günkü rezervasyonumu iptal etmek istedim ve ev sahibi bu konuda yardımcı oldu.
Ev gerçekten temiz değildi, çarşaflar pis, lekeler ve kıllar vardı, evin içinde de bir koku vardı rahatsız etti, çarşafların değiştirilmesini istedik değiştirdiler ama tabi biz gelmeden bunların yapılması yerinde olurdu. Yerler de temiz değildi aynı şekilde (paspas isteyip kendimiz temizledik).
Mutfak da aynı şekilde hiç kullanma amacımız yoktu ama orası da pisti buzdolabının üstündeki tozlar en az 1 haftalıktı ayrıca buzdolabının üstünde sakız vardı.
Ev sahibi (ilk baştaki olumsuz deneyimimi yoksayaraktan) gerçekten yardımcı oluyor ve kendisi iyi biri diyebilirim.

Çok merkezi konumda bulunan bir daire ve Apart Hotel olarak geçiyor. İhtiyaçlarınızı karşılayacak herşey dairede mevcuttu. Tertemiz bir daire. Lokasyonu çok merkezi ve sahile çok yakın bir konumda. reviews.text:

very friendly and helpful owners of the apartment, the apartment is very cozy, clean, has absolutely everything you need, one of the most pleasant moments was a plate of fruit🙏🏻 the location is convenient, a minute from the metro, there is a kitchen and restaurants nearby. description: Stay in the heart of Kadıköy, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant districts. Just 10 minutes to the seafront and steps from the historic bazaar, where you can enjoy Turkish cuisine and fresh seafood. Metro, ferry and airport buses are 5 minutes away. Bars street is 200 m. Enjoy a clean, comfortable and stylish apartment. Licensed for tourist rental by the Ministry of Tourism.

reviews.text: I had an incredible stay at this Airbnb apartment! From the moment I arrived, I felt right at home. The apartment was exactly as described—clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated. The host was incredibly welcoming, providing thoughtful touches like fresh linens, toiletries, and a local guide with recommendations for nearby cafes and attractions. The location was perfect, with easy access to public transport and lots of great spots within walking distance. I really appreciated how well-equipped the kitchen was, making it easy to prepare meals during my stay. Overall, this was a fantastic experience, and I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area! Thank you very much Mehmet! We would love to come back to your beautiful apartment one day!

We absolutely loved our stay in Mehmet's apartment. The location in Kadikoy is very cool, lots of bars and places to eat whilst being just a boat ride away from the main sights. The apartment itself is pristine and very well equipped, the photos say it all really. We didn't use the kitchen for cooking as it was cheap to eat out but you can easily cook meals here. Washer/dryer also handy. Very clear check in instructions and Mehmet responded really promptly and helpfully to my messages. Bedroom is at the back of the apartment so stayed nice and quiet and we slept very well. WiFi worked fine. There was some bottled water left in fridge which was handy as it is advised not to drink the tap water if you're not used to it. We're definitely happy we chose this apartment and will be recommending it to others!

Space
Beautiful, comfortable, and exactly what you want in Istanbul. The apartment was spotless, modern, and well-kept. Everything worked properly, and the unit felt clean, secure, and private. The photos accurately match the real space — no tricks or misleading angles.
Ambiance
Quiet, calm, and relaxing. Plenty of natural light, a simple layout, and a peaceful feel that makes it easy to unwind after long days of exploring the city.
Location / Getting There
Prime Kadıköy location. Minutes from the ferry, great cafés, restaurants, markets, and bakeries. Extremely walkable and safe. As always in Istanbul, expect some hills — built-in cardio that justifies the extra pastries.
Host / Check-In
Mehmet is exceptional. He provides clear video guides for check-in and helpful videos on the neighborhood and local tips. I reached out asking for a place to get a beard trim and he didn’t just recommend a spot — he made it happen. A short walk later, I had a fantastic trim from a local barber.

I’ve rented many Airbnb homes over the years, both in Turkey and abroad, but I can confidently say that this was by far the best place I’ve ever stayed in. Everything was absolutely perfect and thoughtfully prepared for a comfortable stay.
The location is amazing — right in the heart of Kadıköy, close to everything you might need. The check-in process was seamless, thanks to the host’s very clear and detailed instructions.
The cleanliness was impeccable. Towels, bed linens, and pillowcases were fresh, clean, and smelled great. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything you could possibly need — from pots and pans to plates, glasses, and utensils — all of excellent quality. I truly felt at home.
The host has thought of every little detail to ensure the comfort and convenience of their guests. Hosts like this are rare to find. I honestly questioned why I had been staying in hotels during all my previous visits to Kadıköy. From now on, this will be my first choice without a doubt.

Mehmet’s place was wonderful. It was even better than in the photos and considering it’s on a very busy square the sound insulation was brilliant! We always stay in Kadikoy in IST and this is by far the quietest place. The bedroom is at the back so you can also sleep with the window open if you want. The place has everything you need and a lift to the second floor so if you have a lot of luggage it’s easy to get it upstairs. Lots of restaurants and shops in the area, convenient location and walking distance from the ferry.
Mehmet was also really accommodating and kingly met us for the check-in, helped us find the parking which is about 10 meters away from the apartment, and he made sure that we have everything we need for a comfortable stay :)
Communication was flawless and I can definitely recommend Mehmet‘s place and him as a host more importantly! Thanks again Mehmet for everything and see you next time in Istanbul!

description: Enjoy a spacious stay in Bakırköy with beautiful views of the Marmara Sea. Hosted by Homie Suites, this modern two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers generous living spaces, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and air conditioning throughout. Located on Revnaklı Street, you'll be close to Bakırköy's waterfront, cafés, restaurants, shopping, and convenient transportation links to the rest of Istanbul

reviews.text: This had been a truly magical experience because of the sea view and sparkling clean apartment… on par with 5 star hotels. 15 mins walk to the train station and 10 mins to the bustling shopping district where you can find items cheaper than busy areas like Istiklal. The building where the apartment is located is surrounded by much older ones, so it does not have a pristine feel but all of this is a small sacrifice because of the view. A bonus is that it comes with a lift for your heavy luggages, unlike most other apartments in Istanbul. Thank you Tunc for accommodating our early check-in! We will come back next time.

I had a wonderful stay! The host was very kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout my visit. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Communication was easy, and I felt very well taken care of. I would definitely stay here again .

+ Very nice place, and squeaky clean. This place is in match of a 4-star hotel with modern design. The owner is helpful and responds to my messages instantaneously.
- What I didn’t like of its location is that the neighborhood’s roads are like mazes; difficult to get in and out, and very narrow.

Awesome accommodations: clean, spacious, comfortable.
Great response from the host! Thank you!

Our stay at this beautiful apartment was truly exceptional, and my family and I thoroughly enjoyed every moment of it. The apartment was elegant, spotless, comfortable, and very well maintained, providing everything we needed for a relaxing and enjoyable stay.
One of the highlights of our stay was the beautiful view of the Sea of Marmara. Waking up to such a wonderful view and enjoying the peaceful atmosphere was truly special and made our experience even more memorable.
The location is also excellent. Bakırköy’s vibrant shopping area is just a 5-minute walk away, making it incredibly convenient for shopping and exploring. There are also plenty of restaurants, cafés, bakeries, and lovely walking areas surrounding the apartment, so everything you might need is within easy reach.
From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the professionalism and hospitality of the Home Suites team.

description:
The flat is on the Istiklal Street which is the most famous turistical area in Turkey.

Beyoğlu region and Galata was rebuilt after a big fire in 1870. We would define this date as the rebirth of Beyoğlu and say that many important historical buildings in Beyoğlu emerged after this date. The building was completed in 1872 by French architects in a European style. You will feel 150 years of history at the Galata Tower Street, the foot of the tower.

reviews.text:
I absolutely loved the location, 5 mins walking distance from Galata tower and many pretty restaurants/cafes/bars/stores around it.
I would give 4/5 to the building because the stairs are very narrow with no lift. The room is very pretty and cozy, it had most of the amenities (hair dryer, iron, utensils, stove, warm water, toilet paper, small soap/shampoo). They could get better curtains because there was a lot of light coming inside the room early morning but otherwise my stay was comfortable and fun!
The host was also responsive and helpful, would recommend it🤍

Location, location, location. We were walking distance to a lot of great places and metro to go sightseeing. The apartment was squeaky clean and looked exactly like the photos. Place was spacious and cosy. Host were super responsive and accommodating. Would definitely stay here again.
Note that you are beside a busy street so you will hear the music from restaurants. It didn’t bother us as it quiet down when we slept.

Ecem's place felt just like home . We arrived later than expected, but the host was very kind and waited for us to arrive and to provide the keys. Whole place was very clean, with all needed ammenities, as well as complementary turkisk tea, which was a very nice touch. If something happened we received message from the host, informing us of the situation. Very close to the subway, near the funicular or at a walking distance from Galata Tower, the place is worth chosing for one's stay. The only minus was that on Friday and Saturday evening the street is noisy, but this is not something the host can control; and, besides that, the noise stops around 12pm. We highly recommend Ecem's place for a wonderful stay in Istanbul. Thank you for having us.

We recently stayed at this modern and tidy apartment in Istanbul for two nights, and overall, our experience was quite positive. The communication with the host was excellent, and the check-in and checkout processes were smooth and efficient.
The apartment itself was well-maintained, with a modern interior that added a nice touch to our stay. The amenities provided were satisfactory, and we appreciated the cleanliness of the space.
However, the only downside to our stay was the proximity to a disco located next door. On Friday and Saturday nights, the music and singing from the venue were audible until 2 am, making it challenging to get a good night's sleep without earplugs. While this might not be an issue for those who enjoy the vibrant nightlife, it's worth considering for those seeking a quieter stay.
Despite the noise, we still enjoyed our time in Istanbul. If you're a night owl or don't mind some noise during the weekend, this apartment could be a great choice for your stay.

Great flat, spotlessly clean with everything you need with tasteful and well-thought out furnishings. So much more spacious and cozy than a hotel. Location cannot be beat. Steps from quaint cafes and restaurants as well as a metro station and 2 min walk to the funicular which allows you to easily get down to the lower part of the city. The host Ecem was quick to communicate and answer my questions. He was waiting for me upon my arrival to show me the flat and give me the key. His recommendation for Zeytuna restaurant in his guidebook was spot on. It was by far the best restaurant experience during my time in Istanbul. The only downside to this flat (and it is at no fault of the host) is that there is a discotheque across the street. I just happened to be staying there Friday and Saturday night so it was very loud. However, it likely won't be an issue other nights. Overall, I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again. Loved the apartment and the neighborhood!

description: Enjoy sightseeing tours to historical destinations near this comfortable accommodation in the center of the city.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed this apartment. The location is fantastic, set on a lively street with plenty of cafés, restaurants, and shops nearby, while the building itself felt very safe and secure.
One of the biggest advantages is that it’s within walking distance of many of Istanbul’s top attractions, especially Galataport, which became one of our favorite places in the city. It’s also just a short walk to the tram station, making it incredibly easy to explore the rest of Istanbul.
The room looked exactly like the photos and was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained.
The only downside was the bathroom. While it was clean, it was quite small, and the sink was extremely small, which made it a little inconvenient to use.
Other than that, everything was great. We had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a well-located and comfortable place to stay in Istanbul.

We had a wonderful stay here! The location is really great; you can walk everywhere on the Galata side. Our hosts were quick to respond to our wishes (extra blanket, toilet paper, taxi arrangements) so thank you very much! The shower is also nice and has great water pressure :)
I recommend bringing some earplugs as the street next to the apartment is quite lively into the night as well.
It was very comfortable and I highly recommend you stay here :-)

This room was big enough and comfortable for two people, and everyone that managed the front desk were very nice and kind and helpful. The location is excellent!

Great place and host! Quiet from noise at night and during weekends, even though the hotel is in the center of all the action. Arrival and entry is in a completely quiet yet safe cul-de-sac. The rooms are small, but functional and the noise of the surrounding megalopolis does not reach ours at all. We stayed for three nights and never once regretted our choice. We highly recommend and will always be happy to return!

My first impressions are the room where,” whoa this is kinda nice. I threw my stuff on the bed and then checked everything else out. The bathroom looked decent. Couple downsides about the bathroom. The Hotel is very central and close to everything. But the glasses in out room were dirty and the Bathroom was broken
Clean and cozy place, with great location close to local attractions and great restaurants. I spent one week here and had a good time. I would definitely recommend this place!

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Yergul was amazingly kind at our check in. There were some issues relates to the internet, and the bed was not the most comfortable. However the location, the cleanness, and the great communication that she provides (replies within 1 hour at most) makes this a reccomendation for everyone, and an amazing deal for the amount that is to be paid.

Yergül Hanım, çok nazik ve çok ilgiliydi. Konaklamadan 1 hafta önce iletişime geçerek konaklama hakkında detaylı bilgileri sundu. Konakladığım ev çok temiz ve hijyenikti. reviews.text:
Sam is a great and responsive host. Good heating and hot water. Decent location, although there is an uphill walk to the nearest shops. Clean. There is a coffee maker + a microwave.
Cons:
- No clear self check-in instructions (floor? apt. number?).
- Squeaky interior doors and creaking floors.
- Small gaps in the bedroom windows = drafts.
- A few electrical outlets, they are in inconvenient places.
- Very old appliances: a noisy fridge and a very noisy washing machine that makes clanking sounds.
- Upon check-in, the shower was broken, had to call Sam to fix it. The shower head holder remained broken.
- Poor drainage in the shower cabin, the bathroom is cramped, moisture on the floor, a persistent sewage smell, and the bathroom door does not lock.
- Slow internet, even by Turkish standards (↑3 ↓15 Mbps).
- No basic items like sugar / cooking oil (at least there is laundry detergent 👍).
- The gas stove lit using lighters.
Overall, not worth $424 per week, despite the location.

Sweet apartment! It was clean, fully equipped (with a steamer!:)), cozy to stay and totally fine for us 3 friends. Clean simple kitchen, at the same time very good restaurants nearby, so no need to cook. One bedroom includes double bed and single bed. Living room has a table with chairs, as well as a couch to sit. Enough towels and basic soaps in the bathroom. Nice balcony with view on the stairs. Very central and easy to access all areas, the stairs are a good workout! Samet is also very helpful and easily available via messenger, thank you! 🧿

Samet is a great host. Very responsive, helpful and friendly. The apartment is in a great location. Close to attractions, restaurants and shops. The apartment is very comfortable, actually bigger than it appears on the photos, especially the bedroom. Very comfortable for 1 - 3 people. Lots of storage/closet space.
Although it is close to many locations of interest the street where it is located is very quiet and private. And, special plus if you come by car - parking is free on the street, right in front of the apartment building. Highly recommended!

Sam was a great host friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout our stay. Check-in was smooth, and communication was always quick and easy.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a convenient location. Overall, we had a pleasant stay and appreciated the host’s hospitality.
The only thing future guests should be aware of is that the apartment does not have air conditioning. If you’re visiting during the summer, it can get quite warm, so it’s something to keep in mind when booking.
Thank you, Sam, for your hospitality!

Nice location, easy to check-in, good wi-fi. The apartment was clean. The plumbing needs renovation: to fix the toilet, the pipes under the sink are leaking, there’s no cold water in the sink, the paint on the tiles is peeling off, and the kitchen faucet is unstable. We were staying in August and therefore it was too hot for an apartment without an air conditioner. I would recommend this airbnb for colder seasons.

description: This brand new eclectic 1+1 is very centrally located within a luxury commercial compound w/ indoor & outdoor pool w/ hot tub, basketball court, gym, jacuzzi&sauna. Facilities such as a roof top swimming pool, gym & sauna & steam room we're used regularly and are excellent. the staff at reception were also very helpful and friendly

Alara was a very nice host, she is very helpful and always response fast. The house is very nice and very clean as well, the location is super and close to almost everywhere. And it was also an easy to check in. Thank you

Alara Hanım çok ilgili ve yardımsever bir ev sahibi. Kafamdaki soruların hepsini hızlı bir şekilde cevaplandırarak rahat etmemi sağladı. Evin konumu her yere yakın olması nedeniyle oldukça iyi. Beklediğim her şey eksiksizdi. Şarap açacağına kadar her şey ince düşünülmüş. 2 gün boyunca kendi evimde gibi hissettim. Her şey için çok teşekkürler.

description: A small house within walking distance to the beach and inside the village. A place where you can enjoy the silence and tranquility for those looking for calm and serenity, relax and find peace with its fresh air.

reviews.text:
a perfect getaway for a couple or a single traveller. quiet, cozy, comfortable. shops and restaurants are very close (though anything but fancy). 5 mins walk to the beach. the house is exactly as described, Berkay is friendly and responsive and respect the guest's privacy.
highly recommended.

Evin konumu denize ve yeşilliğe ulaşılabilir bir şekildedir. İlk dikkat ettiğimiz bebeğimiz olması sebebiyle temizlik durumuydu ve gayet temizdi. Berkay Bey ve ailesi sıcak ve yardımseverdi. Evin en büyük eksiği bulaşık makinesinin olmaması, zamanımızın belli bir kısmı malesef ev işi ile geçti. Bahçe fotoğraflara göre biraz daha küçüktü. Evin konum olarak çarşıya yakın olması büyük bir avantaj. Havanın durumu sebebiyle denize giremedik, inanılmaz büyük dalgalar vardı. Çocuklu aileler için evin sıcaklığı pek uygun gelmedi bize. Isınma ve soğutma için klima yetersizdi. Özellikle gece klima açmamıza rağmen yatak odasını hiç ısıtamadık. Tabii yetişkinler için bu mevsimde sorun olmayabilir, biz genellikle bebekli aileler için yorumluyoruz. Havanın sıcak olduğu mevsimde tekrar deneyimlemek istiyoruz. Huzurlu bir dört gündü.

Çok keyifli bir konaklama yaşadık. Öncelikle ev tam olarak fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi, mutfak, banyo nevresimler havlular son derece temizdi, hiç tereddütsüz kullandık. Mutfak malzemeleri temel yiyecekleri hazırlamak için yeterliydi, varıştan önce sorduğumuzda Berkay bey çok yakında oturdukları için ihtiyaç olursa mutfak araç gereci temin edebileceklerini de iletmişti ancak bizim ihtiyacımız olmadı. Ev son derece keyifli döşenmiş, küçük bahçesi son derece huzurlu ve ağustos ayının ortası olmasına rağmen yemyeşildi. Ev Yalıköy merkezde, zincir marketlere ve köyde yemek yiyebileceğiniz yerlere en fazla beş dakika mesafede. Denize de oldukça yakın, biz eşyalarımız oldugu içi arabayla gittik ama yürüyerek de rahatlıkla gidilebilir. Kumsal bizim için keyifliydi, deniz dalgalıydı ancak küçük kızımız oldugundan kıyıda oynayarak da güzel vakit geçirdik. 9:30 - 19:00 arası belediyenin cankurtaran hizmeti var. Cumartesi ve pazar günleri bile rahatsız edici bir kalabalık yoktu.

2 gece 3 gün konakladığımız bu şirin evimizde biz kendimizi çok rahat ve güvende hissettik kız kardeşimle beraber geçirdiğim kısa ama dolu dolu geçen bir tatil oldu ev tamamen fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi çok tatlı bi ev ve çok temizdi konumu da çok iyi çevrede her türlü alışverişinizi yapabileceğiniz işletme mevcut sahile de çok yakın yürüyerek bile gidebilirsiniz ayrıca sabah kahvaltılarımızda berkay bey’in babaannesi bahçelerinden taze taze salatalık biber ve erik ikram etti o da çok nazik biriydi unutamicağımız bir şey de kediler her gün farklı farklı kediler bahçemize geldi ve hepsi çok güzeldi hayvanseverler için muhteşem bir yer gerçekten en yakın zamanda hatta her boş vakit bulduğumda gelicez her şey için teşekkür ederiz 🥹🥹🫶🏻

Berkay Bey, çok kibar ve beyefendi bir ev sahibi. Bizi babası karşıladı aynı şekilde babası da beyefendi güleryüzlü birisiydi. Ev tam olarak fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi; çok tatlı, çok güzel. Temizlik de güzel yapılmış. Fakat girdiğiniz andan itibaren ağır bir koku var. Sebebini anlayamadık küf olabilir rutubet olabilir bilmiyorum ama bi oda kokusu konulması faydalı olabilir çünkü korku gerçekten rahatsız ediyor.

description:
In this unique and tranquil place, slow down and relax, and greet the day with the sounds of birds in touch with nature. You can barbecue in our garden and enjoy a nice dinner on your terrace with a view
We are 50 minutes away from Istanbul by car

reviews.text: Doğayla iç içe, huzurlu ve gerçekten keyifli bir konaklama geçirdik. İş sebebiyle girişimiz geç oldu ancak konaklamamız çok güzeldi, keşke daha fazla zamanımız olsaydı da uzatabilseydik. Ev çok temiz hem de fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi. Sabah kuş sesleriyle uyanıp doğanın içinde vakit geçirmek inanılmaz iyi geldi. En güzeli ise ev sahibi Anıl Bey’in ilgisi ve samimiyetiydi. Saat 22.00 da bile mangalımıza yardımcı oldu, kendimizi gerçekten misafir gibi değil evimizde gibi hissettik. Güler yüzü ve misafirperverliği için ayrıca teşekkür ederiz. Kesinlikle tekrar gelmek isteyeceğimiz bir yer oldu kışın da tekrar gideceğiz, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz 🤍

The place was really nice. Beautiful spot in the mountain. Relax and feel at peace. All that nice stuff. Couple issues to keep in mind. Internet is an issue. We had some serious issues with the sportiness of the signal as the modem was not in the cabin. Although we were closest, still lost connection often. The water was really nice, but did not last for more than 5-10 minutes which is unideal when tring to take a nice shower. Overall stay was nice. Host was kind. Cats were cute. Do kind of need car as you are a 5 minute drive to city. Safe parking for your car so perfect in that regard.

The bungalow has a beautiful view and is a very comfortable place for stay when coming to Agva. We did not have a car so Anil was very generous in driving us to and from the center when possible. The home is spacious, clean and light. Exactly as described. You can hear cats and crickets, otherwise it is very quiet.

Nişanlım ile 1 gün konaklama yaptık, ev sahibi aracımız olmadığı için yardımcı oldu ulaşımda. Havası tertemiz oksijen dolu doğanın içinde teknolojik şeylerden uzak kafa dinlemelik stres atmalık huzur dolu bir yer. Manzarası çok iyi. Mangalı yakarken ev sahibi yine yardım etti sağolsun. Odalar ve mekan gayet temiz ve düzenliydi, herhangi bir sorun yaşamadık. Gönül rahatlığıyla gidebilirsiniz. Market alışverişinizi yapıp gelin, sonra huzurun tadını çıkarın.
Anıl bey sağolsun çok ilgilendi konum rahat agva merkeze 7-8 dakika sürüyor araç ile havası temiz bir yerde uyanmak istiyorsaniz kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum aile ortamı.

description:
we will be happy to welcome. you feel like in your own home!

feel at home!

Taksim square is 5 minutes away. A wonderfully pleasant and modern house on a busy street where you can find what you are looking for all day, within walking distance.

reviews.text: Extremely misleading listing. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator, which was never mentioned. There are no photos of the building, entrance, or stairway—and for good reason. The place looks nothing like the photos. Upon check-in, the host was inside the apartment and insisted on taking passport copies, which felt invasive and disrespectful. He also asked us to walk barefoot inside, even though the apartment has no carpets and was not properly cleaned—there were even leftovers in the fridge. The stairwell was dark, narrow, and unsafe. We left just minutes after arriving, yet the host refused to refund even a single dollar of our 7-night stay. He showed no care or professionalism—only concern for his payment. It’s shocking how this place has high ratings. It was a complete disappointment and nothing like what we expected. We left because our safety, privacy, and peace of mind matter more than money. Not recommended at all

We stayed in the apartment for 6 days and had an amazing experience! The location is perfect – everything you need is nearby, from cafes and shops to main attractions. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly helpful and kind, always quick to respond and ready to assist with anything we needed. Would definitely recommend and stay here again! ❤️

We had a wonderful stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was convenient, and everything we needed was available. The host was friendly, responsive, and made sure we had a smooth and enjoyable experience. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!

Absolutely loved our stay at Ky’s! My family stayed here for a family trip & the place was exactly as shown in the pictures—clean, stylish, and very comfortable. The host was a fantastic communicator, always quick to respond and very helpful with any questions we had. The only downside was that there is no lift, just stairs, which could be challenging for some. Overall, a great experience and highly recommended!

The Ky is super host and respectful, the apartment is beyond description and much spacious than what you see in the photos, love all the details and super comfy beds, kitchen is fully equipped.
The location is perfect and near to sisli for 10 min walk max, and to istiklal street for 2 kilometers away , love the privacy too .
Will be my fav place when I visit Istanbul always 🫶🏼

description: We will be happy to welcome you to our suite on the 2nd floor of our facility, which has a 24/7 reception. It is located 3 minutes from Galatasaray High School on Istiklal Avenue. It is a 2-minute walk to the bus stop and a 15-minute walk to the metro stops. You can have breakfast at our hotel with our affordable breakfast menu. Wi-Fi, air conditioning and central heating are available in our rooms. Access to the rooms is provided by stairs.

reviews.text: Zübeyde Hanımın hızlı ve çözüm odaklı geri dönüşleri hem giriş öncesinde hem de konaklama sırasında harikaydı. Ev fotoğrafta olduğu gibiydi ve temizdi. Mutfakta ocakla alakalı bir sorun yaşadığımızda ev sahibi başka bir ocak getirerek bu sorunumuzu da çözdü. Kısaca ev ve ev sahibi ile olumsuz bir deneyim yaşamadık. Konum olarak zaten bilindiği üzere de Beyoğlu/Taksim bölgelerinin geç saatlerde sokaklarının çok tekin olmaması ve rahat gezememek söz konusu. Harici olarak sokakların çok dar ve düzensiz olmasından dolayı otopark sıkıntısı da mevcut. Bizim gibi aracı ile gelecek olanların biraz erken gelip evin konumu ve çevresini bayağı bi turlayıp arabalarını park edecek bir boşluk bulmaları gerekiyor.

Honest review ahead after living for 6 nights.
- location was perfect near Omer Hayyam station / isteklal street.
- kitchen, AC and water were perfectly working.
- Apartment was small as compared to photos. Washroom was really small and there was no holder for any clothes, shampoos and any other amenities. The shower cant be fixed i was adjusted it every-time during the shower.
- internet was not working upto the mark. I had to use my Phone data a lot of times. I complained to the owner but message was left on seen.
- bed was just ok. The backside was making noises when moved on the bed.
- the apartment was on 2nd story. Stairs were really small and hard to get luggage in the room also the outside lights of the floors were not working properly. Hit the stairs 4 to 5 times because of no light in the stairway.
Overall I recommend to stay here if the bathroom gets a bit better. Other than that always keep your phone’s flash light on while on the stairs.

Good location, solid price, Host very responsive, made check in flexible even though I made the reservation on very short notice.
The room was clean, bed was comfy, nothing wow but worth the price. Only thing I would note as unpleasant was sound isolation, there basically isn't any. Overall, for short term stay, very good.

Had a comfortable stay. The apartment was very clean and well located close to a main avenue, supermarkets and at a walkable distance to Taksim square. The host was very kind and responsive. Thank you for hosting.

Excellent Host and Welcoming Space
Our host was exceptionally warm and attentive, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The house was immaculate, perfectly matching the inviting images in the listing. Its prime location is a significant advantage, with key attractions and amenities within easy walking distance.
One aspect potential guests should be aware of is the home's historical charm, which comes with a characteristic challenge: narrow, circular vintage stairs. Without an elevator, accessing the second floor can be challenging, especially for those traveling with large or heavy luggage. Guests with mobility limitations or substantial baggage might find the staircase somewhat difficult to navigate.
Despite this minor inconvenience, every other aspect of our stay was delightful. The combination of the host's hospitality, the pristine condition of the home, and its convenient location made for a memorable experience.

description: Bright 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Moda, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Just a 10-minute walk from Kadıköy Ferry Port and 15 minutes from the Moda park. Surrounded by cafés, restaurants, and boutique shops, it’s the perfect base to enjoy the city’s creative energy and lively street life.

reviews.text: The airbnb is overall a nice place and the location is excellent. However, the wifi rarely worked or worked very slowly, even after changing networks as the host suggested. The TV never worked properly. Also, the airbnb felt unclean, and the lack of basic cleaning products added to that feeling. We had to use our flashlights to walk up the stairs because the lighting didn’t work properly. Would definitely recommend this Airbnb, but some changes are needed to be made by the hosts in order to get it accurate to the way it is listed.

This was a perfect location for our last few days in Turkiye as we started to wind down and wanted to explore a more "local" and less touristy neighborhood. The apartment was laid out well, the beds all comfortable, linens great, there were comforters as well which was a nice touch. The bathroom was very modern. The AC worked great throughout the apartment and we really enjoyed spending time in the apartment as well as the neighborhood. Demir communicated promptly and helped us whenever we had questions. He also had a great booklet of recommendations. I would stay here again, was also a great price for the apartment and location!
Excellent location. The flat was very comfortable and clean and the host was very helpful. I would stay again.
It was one of the cleanest (place, sheets, towels, kitchen) Airbnb stays I've had so far. The host is very polite and helpful, and the place is very comfortable and nicely furnished.

Great stay in vibrant Kadıköy! The location is unbeatable, right in the heart of downtown, with ferries, trains, restaurants, and grocery stores all within a 5-minute walk. Everything you need is literally steps away.
Hanemo was an outstanding host, super responsive and helpful. He arranged drinking water deliveries for us and even saved the day when we accidentally locked ourselves out by quickly organizing a locksmith.
The only downside was the internet: speeds were slower than ideal, and on our last two days there was an unexpected outage that wasn’t fixed before checkout.
Overall, a wonderful apartment and host, highly recommend!

description:
Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place.
Metrobus is right at the doorstep, 24/7 public transportation to all parts of Istanbul. Torium shopping mall is 4 minutes, Marmara Park is 10 minutes, Tuyap Fair Center is 15 minutes away. Hospitals around the site are 10-15 minutes away. Starbucks, Migros, File, Bim, Anpa Gros, etc. markets, cafes, pharmacies are within walking distance

reviews.text: The apartment is in a convenient area, with shops and cafés nearby. Check-in went smoothly, and the host was responsive and answered questions quickly. The place has everything needed for a short stay. However, it wasn’t very clean upon arrival — a bit more attention to cleanliness would make the stay more comfortable. Overall, it’s suitable for a short visit.

Volkan is a great host, very responsive, flexible, helpful and friendly. The apartment is at the exact described location which is what we needed for the time being in Istanbul. I would recommend this place.

We would like to thank to Volkan for being such a responsible and nice host. We stay in Istanbul very often and all the time we had problems. This is really the first place we can recommend!:) Everything is very clean, especially in the kitchen there are all necessary equipment for cooking, bedding was also very clean , the flat is very light and there is air conditioner ( was very necessary )
Everything was great , we are satisfied and will come back

Bekletimizin altında kaldı. Otoparkta tadilat varmış, araç yeri bulmakta zorlandık. Otopark bizim için önemli mevzuydu. Banyo temiz değildi. Duş kabininde başkasına ait jilet vardı. Giriş yaparken de zorlandık biraz. Salon ve yatak odası idare eder.

Konumu bulması kolaydı. Volkan Bey gerçekten çok ilgili bir ev sahibi her konuda yardimci oldu, sıcakkanlılığını hissettirdi ve şunu rahatlıkla söyleyebilirim ki gördüğüm en temiz evlerden biriydi özellikle havlu kokusuna bayıldım. Evin güzel bir gece manzarası var. Şiddetle tavsiye ederim. 4/4 lük bir ev ve ev sahibi. Buradan tekrar teşekkürlerimi sunuyorum. ❤️
